release.description:
Windsor.ai connects your marketing and business data sources to your AI assistant, so you can ask questions and take action in plain English.

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions across every connected ad account
- Find and pause an underperforming Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads campaign
- Post or reply as your Instagram, Threads, Facebook, or Google Business Profile account
- Pull GA4, Google Search Console, or YouTube Analytics data straight into the conversation
- Sync HubSpot, Salesforce, or Shopify records
- Update a Klaviyo flow or an Amazon Seller Central listing

Reading data only requires connecting the relevant account once. Making a change (pausing a campaign, posting content, replying to a review) always asks for your confirmation first, and it is only available on platforms Windsor explicitly supports write access for. Every other connected source is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

Granola MCP connects your meeting history to ChatGPT so your assistant can pull real context from past conversations while you work.

release.description:
Create images, videos, branded content, and websites with Higgsfield in ChatGPT. Start with an idea or reference image, choose a creative model or preset, and refine your results through conversation.

With Higgsfield, you can:

• Generate images and videos from text or reference images. Create portraits, illustrations, cinematic scenes, or bring a still photo to life.

• Browse image and video presets, or apply a named preset such as @Higgsfield /main-character or /brand-monument to a reference image.

• Create product photoshoots, brand identities, packaging mockups, social graphics, YouTube thumbnails, and Instagram covers.

• Use Ad Multiplier to create independent variations of an existing video ad. Change selected people, products, clothing, objects, backgrounds, or text while preserving untargeted elements.

• Make AI-generated UGC-style content, including product showcases, unboxings, tutorials, and fashion try-ons. Create website and app promos with a virtual presenter and real screenshots.

• Produce faceless videos, narrated explainers, and episodes with a consistent AI presenter. Write complete YouTube scripts, generate spoken narration, and add subtitles.

• Edit footage and create motion graphics with animated text, layouts, transitions, and effects. Receive rendered videos and editable project files for supported workflows.

• Build and deploy websites, web apps, and browser games. Create visual assets, refine the design, and update your hosted project through chat.

Describe what you want to make, review the results in chat, and build on your previous creations.

Connect your Higgsfield account to get started.

release.description:
Play chess without leaving ChatGPT. Start a new game in seconds, make moves in normal chess language, and talk about every part of the game as you play. You can ask why a move is good, why a move is bad, what to do next, or how to get better. This app is made for people who want to play, learn, and have fun at the same time.

The app is easy to use. Just begin a game and make your moves. You can use simple move names, standard chess notation, or ask questions in plain English. If you are not sure what to do, ask for help. The game keeps going while you chat, so learning feels natural instead of like reading a long lesson.

If you are brand new to chess, this app is a friendly place to start. It explains ideas in small, simple steps. It tells you what each piece can do and why some moves are stronger than others. You never have to pretend you understand. Just ask another question. You can learn one move at a time.

If you already know how to play, you can go deeper. Talk about openings, middle games, endgames, tactics, strategy, planning, and common mistakes. Ask why a position feels better for one side. Compare different moves. Explore new ideas. The conversation changes to fit your questions.

Play at your own speed. Think for a long time or move quickly. Stop to ask about a position. Go back and look at an earlier move. Try a different idea and see what could happen. Chess is not only about finding the best move. It is also about understanding why that move works.

The app can explain forks, pins, skewers, discovered attacks, double checks, sacrifices, passed pawns, king safety, piece activity, space, time, and many other chess ideas using clear language. Hard topics become easier because you can ask for another explanation whenever you need one.

Want to improve? Review your games after they finish. Talk about turning points, missed chances, and strong moves. Ask where the game changed. Find patterns in your play. Learn from mistakes instead of simply seeing that they happened. Every game becomes a chance to get stronger.

You can also practice specific parts of chess. Focus on openings you want to remember. Study endgames that appear often. Learn how to attack, defend, trade pieces, or make better plans. Ask for tips that match your current skill level instead of getting the same advice every player receives.

The conversation is just as important as the game. Ask “What if I move here?” Ask “What was my best move?” Ask “Why did my attack fail?” Ask “Can you explain that in a simpler way?” The app is built for questions, so you are never limited to playing in silence.

There is no need to switch between different tools just to play and learn. The chessboard and the conversation work together. You make a move, ask a question, get an answer, and keep playing. Everything happens in one place, making practice smooth and enjoyable.

Whether you play one game a week or many games every day, the app is ready. Beginners can build confidence. Casual players can have fun. Club players can explore ideas. Anyone who enjoys chess can have interesting conversations while playing.

Use the app to play complete games, test new ideas, understand difficult positions, review finished games, and discover better moves. Learn at your own pace. Stay curious. Ask as many questions as you like. Every move is another chance to think, learn, and enjoy the game. If you want a chess game that also talks with you, teaches you, and helps you improve inside ChatGPT, this app is ready to play.

release.description:
12andus Astrology delivers professional-grade astrological insights powered by precise calculations and personalized charts analysis.

What You Can Explore

Personality & Psychological Insights
Discover your strengths, challenges, emotional patterns, and inner motivations based on your unique birth chart. Understand how you think, love, work, and
make decisions through the lens of your planetary placements.

Timing Guidance & Forecasts
Receive personalized transit forecasts for up to one year ahead, revealing upcoming periods of growth, change, opportunity, or challenge. See when
key planetary influences begin and end.

Relationship Compatibility
Explore the dynamics between you and anyone else through synastry analysis (how your charts interact) and composite charts (the unique energy your
relationship creates together). For romantic relationships, understand the chemistry of attraction, emotional compatibility, communication styles, intimacy patterns, and long-term potential. The same depth of analysis applies to any relationship — family bonds, friendships, business partnerships, or professional collaborations. See where you naturally harmonize, where friction may arise, and how to navigate differences with greater awareness.

Relationship Timing
Go beyond static compatibility — see how transiting planets activate your composite chart, revealing the best times for important relationship milestones,
conversations, or decisions.

Key Features
- Private Birth Data Storage — Securely save up to 50 birth charts under your account for instant access to readings without re-entering data
- Birth Charts — Complete natal analysis including planets, houses, aspects, and retrograde positions
- Transit Charts — Forecasts from 1 day to 365 days showing active planetary influences
- Relationship Charts — Synastry and composite analysis between any two saved people
- Relationship Forecasts — Transits to composite charts revealing relationship timing

Unmatched Precision
12andus calculations consider the exact planetary positions based on your specific birth date, time, and place. When birth time is unknown, the system adapts intelligently, providing insights without house-dependent data.

Holistic Readings
Unlike fragmented interpretations that list placements one by one, 12andus synthesizes your chart holistically — weaving together planetary positions, aspects, and houses into a unified narrative that reflects how these energies actually work together in your life.

release.description: GSC Wizard connects ChatGPT to your own Google Search Console properties so you can analyze SEO performance in plain language. Ask for a performance summary, your top queries and pages, ranking changes between two periods, content decay, keyword cannibalization, CTR-versus-position curves, or a full SEO report, and get a finished answer back. Instead of streaming thousands of raw rows into the model, every analysis is computed server-side against a data warehouse, so results are fast, accurate, and token-efficient. You can also list and inspect properties, run Google's URL Inspection, track indexing, manage topic clusters and content groups, and submit URLs to IndexNow. It also reports on your own linked Google Analytics 4 properties: traffic overviews, dimension breakdowns, ecommerce, key events (conversions), traffic referred by AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity, and blended Search Console + GA4 landing-page views. Summary tools render interactive cards and tables directly in ChatGPT. All access is scoped to your own account through Google sign-in.

release.description:
Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into ChatGPT for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.

Search for companies. Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language and filter by industry (including LinkedIn industry, NAICS, and SIC classifications), employee count, revenue range, location, funding stage, and the technologies a company uses. Results come back as structured lists you can refine, rank, and export.

Find the right people. Search professional contacts by job title, seniority, department, location, skills, and work history. Look up a specific person by name and company, or map the decision-makers across a target account, including org structure and reporting lines, to plan multi-threaded outreach.

Get contact details. Retrieve business emails and phone numbers for the contacts you find, with verification status included, so outreach lists are ready to use. Fill gaps in partial records, for example a name and company with no email. Verify email addresses you already have before a send, and flag records that need replacing.

Track buying signals. See which companies raised funding, announced news, grew headcount, opened relevant job listings, or had key people change roles. Use these events to time outreach, score leads, and prioritize accounts.

Enrich your existing records. Paste or upload a list of companies or contacts and append firmographics, technographics, contact details, and recent signals. The app matches records to the right company or person, flags duplicates, and returns a clean table you can export to CSV for your CRM, ATS, or outreach tools.

Who it's for. Sales teams and SDRs building qualified pipeline. Recruiters sourcing candidates by role, skills, and location. RevOps and marketing teams segmenting accounts, sizing markets, and improving CRM data quality. It also supports market sizing and TAM analysis, lead scoring, territory planning, and account-based marketing list building.

Try prompts like:

"Find US SaaS companies with 100 to 1,000 employees that use HubSpot."
"Identify VP-level decision-makers at these accounts and get verified work emails."
"Enrich this list with industry, employee count, revenue, and tech stack."
"Which of these companies raised funding or grew headcount in the last 6 months?"
"Find backend engineers in Austin with fintech experience and get their profiles."
"Build a target account list for my ICP and rank it by fit."
"Map the sales leadership org chart at this company."
"Verify the emails in this list and flag the risky ones."
"Estimate how many US companies match this ICP."
"Write a personalized cold email opener for each contact based on their company's recent news."
Vibe Prospecting is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live at query time, not from a static export, so results reflect current company and contact information.

release.description:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.

release.description:
Follow every match in one simple place. This ChatGPT app helps you see fixtures, live scores, results, league tables, and team details without jumping between lots of websites. Pick your league, choose your favorite club, and quickly find the games and information you want. Everything is laid out in a clean, easy-to-read view so you can spend more time enjoying football and less time searching for it.

The app is made for everyone. You do not need to know football statistics or understand complicated menus. If you only want to know who is playing today, you can. If you want to check how your team is doing in the league, you can do that too. Every screen is designed to be simple, fast, and easy to understand.

Browse competitions from around the world, including the biggest leagues and tournaments. Select a competition to see the current standings, upcoming fixtures, completed matches, and club information. Change leagues with a tap and instantly see new results. Whether you support one team or follow many competitions, the app keeps everything together in one place.

Choose any team to make the experience even more personal. When you select a club, you can quickly find its upcoming matches, recent results, and position in the table. No more scrolling through pages filled with teams you do not follow. The app helps you focus on the football that matters most to you.

The league table is clear and easy to read. See each club’s position, matches played, wins, draws, losses, points, and goal difference at a glance. Tables update as results change, making it simple to keep track of the season. Whether your team is chasing the title, fighting for Europe, or trying to avoid relegation, you can see where they stand in seconds.

Match information is presented in a clean and organized way. Check who is playing, when the match starts, and how the game ended once it is finished. Live scores and completed results are easy to follow, helping you stay connected even when you cannot watch the match.

The simple design works well on different screen sizes and keeps distractions to a minimum. Clear navigation makes moving between competitions, teams, and matches feel natural. Large text, familiar football icons, and organized tables make information easy to find for both new and experienced fans.

Because the app runs inside ChatGPT, you can also ask questions naturally. Instead of searching through menus, you can ask about a team’s recent matches, league position, or upcoming fixtures. ChatGPT helps you find answers quickly while the app presents the information in a structured format.

Whether you follow football every day or only check scores on weekends, this app saves time. It brings together fixtures, results, standings, and team information in one place so you always know what is happening. It is useful before a match, during the action, and after the final whistle.

Key features include:

* Easy competition selection.
* Team filtering for faster browsing.
* Live scores and finished match results.
* Upcoming fixtures.
* League tables with wins, draws, losses, points, and goal difference.
* Clean, simple interface.
* Fast navigation between competitions and clubs.
* Natural language support through ChatGPT.

From the first match of the season to the last, this app makes following football simple. Open it, choose a league, pick a team, and see the information you need in just a few taps. Whether you support a local club, a Premier League giant, or teams from leagues around the world, this app keeps football easy to follow, easy to understand, and always close at hand.

release.description:
Your AI Research Assistant lets you search 350M+ research papers, chat with large volumes of research PDFs, and save findings to your Wisebase (knowledge base).

1. Global Academic Search (Search & Read)
- Major Sources: Search 350M+ papers from Google Scholar, PubMed, arXiv, and more.
- Read Instantly: Access full papers instantly to verify findings.

2. Build Your Knowledge Base (Save & Collect)
- Save for Continuous Research: Save searched papers to Wisebase for continuous questioning and deep analysis of your findings.
- Save Chat History: Save key research discussions as editable documents to capture and refine insights.

3. Unified Knowledge Analysis (Agentic RAG)
- Chat with Your Collection: Analyze your entire collection simultaneously.
- Traceable Sources: Get grounded answers with precise Reference Indices to verify every claim.

4. Visual Knowledge Organization (Visualize & Explore)
- Knowledge Graphing: Instantly generate interactive graphs from any paper to explore definitions, cause-and-effect links, and concept hierarchies.

Ideal Use Cases: For researchers, PhD students, and academics who need to access massive academic sources and synthesize grounded arguments with precise citations.

How to Use in ChatGPT
1. Connect App: Connect Sider Scholar to ChatGPT.
2. Trigger: Type “@Sider Scholar".

Sample Prompts
- Search Paper: “@Sider Scholar Search recent papers on 'LLM alignment' published in the last two years.”
- Chat with Knowledge Base: “@Sider Scholar Answer questions about 'CRISPR gene editing' using my Knowledge Base.”
- Visual Research: “@Sider Scholar Build a Knowledge Graph explaining key concepts in 'Reinforcement Learning'.”

release.description:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Keep designing in conversation. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." "I marked pin A — put the front door exactly there." Furniture placement is automatic — it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a plan? Upload the real CAD file your architect sent — DWG or vector PDF, up to 100MB — and WalkMyPlan converts it into the same editable, walkable 3D model, so you start from reality instead of a blank page.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a garden" — then "walk me through it."

skills.name: find-hackathon
skills.description: Discover which Devpost hackathon is open to enter before starting the guided flow. Use when the user wants to find, search, or browse hackathons, asks for a recommendation ("recommend a hackathon", "which hackathon fits me/my project"), or asks what hackathons are open or upcoming. This is the pre-stepper discovery step; setup and registration happen in $start-hackathon.

interface.short_description: Browse open Devpost hackathons and pick one
interface.default_prompt: Use $find-hackathon to see what hackathons are open, get a recommendation, and pick one to enter.

skills.name: hackathon-map
skills.description: Orient the participant — show the command map, current project progress, deadline/readiness context, and the next recommended command. Use when the user asks what commands are available or what this can do, asks how to get started with the hackathon or Devpost, seems confused, stuck, or unsure what to do next, wants to resume after context loss, or wants to know what to do next.

interface.short_description: Show the flow, commands, and progress state
interface.default_prompt: Use $hackathon-map to show my Devpost Hackathon progress and next step.

skills.name: prepare-submission
skills.description: Draft the participant's Devpost submission materials from the current project and saved state. Use when the user has a build worth describing and needs help preparing the title, write-up, testing notes, screenshots, and demo materials. Drafting only — nothing is sent to Devpost from this command.

interface.short_description: Draft submission copy and required assets
interface.default_prompt: Use $prepare-submission to draft my Devpost submission materials from this project.

skills.name: resources
skills.description: Show the participant's resource hub for working through the hackathon with Codex, including docs, inspiration, and anti-pattern guidance. Use when the user wants hackathon resources, wants inspiration, or needs a reminder of what kinds of projects to avoid.

interface.short_description: Show build resources and anti-pattern guidance
interface.default_prompt: Use $resources to show the Devpost Hackathon resources and anti-pattern guidance.

skills.name: review-hackathon-rules
skills.description: Strategic preflight for the hackathon — present the official picture (rules, eligibility, key dates, prizes, judging criteria, submission obligations), capture explicit acknowledgment of the terms, then offer a short conversation about the participant's idea and strategy. Use when the user is starting the hackathon, wants to size up the event or sanity-check their idea, or needs to re-check official requirements.

interface.short_description: Review rules, judging, key dates, and strategy
interface.default_prompt: Use $review-hackathon-rules to review the hackathon rules, judging criteria, and submission requirements.

skills.name: start-hackathon
skills.description: Start the Devpost Hackathon workflow in the current project folder and register for the event. Use when the user wants to begin the guided experience, initialize the local state file, register on Devpost, or understand the end-to-end flow before working through the event in Codex.

interface.short_description: Begin the guided Codex hackathon flow
interface.default_prompt: Use $start-hackathon to start the Devpost Hackathon flow in this folder.

skills.name: submit-project
skills.description: Submit the project to Devpost — run the final readiness check against the hackathon requirements and the prepared draft, then, after explicit user confirmation, actually submit via the Devpost MCP and verify it landed. Use when the user is ready to submit, wants the final checklist, or asks whether they have submitted.

interface.short_description: Final check, then actually submit your project
interface.default_prompt: Use $submit-project to run the final check and submit my project to Devpost.

release.description:
Find hidden words, have fun every day, and give your brain a happy workout. Our Word Search game is easy to play, relaxing, and full of exciting puzzles for every age. Whether you have a few minutes or a whole afternoon, you can enjoy thousands of word searches anytime. Play at home, on the bus, during a break, or before bed. There is always a new puzzle waiting for you.

Each puzzle is filled with hidden words. Look across, down, up, backward, or diagonal to find them all. Tap or drag across the letters to mark each word. Finish the list to solve the puzzle and move on to the next challenge. The controls are simple, so anyone can start playing in seconds.

There are puzzles for beginners and experts. Start with easy games or test yourself with harder challenges. As you play, you will spot words faster, learn new words, and build your confidence. Every completed puzzle feels rewarding and keeps you coming back for one more game.

Choose from many fun topics. Search for animals, food, nature, space, sports, travel, music, holidays, science, colors, jobs, and much more. Every theme brings a fresh collection of words to discover, making each puzzle feel new and exciting.

Play whenever you want, even without an internet connection. This makes the game perfect for travel, waiting rooms, flights, road trips, camping, or anywhere you want quiet entertainment. Your next puzzle is always ready.

Need a little help? Use hints if you get stuck. They point you in the right direction so you can keep having fun without feeling frustrated. Whether you are learning or challenging yourself, hints make every puzzle enjoyable.

The clean design is easy on your eyes. Bright letters, smooth controls, and clear layouts make finding words simple and comfortable. Play for a few minutes or enjoy longer sessions without distractions.

Word Search is more than a game. It is a relaxing way to exercise your mind. Finding hidden words helps improve focus, attention, spelling, vocabulary, and pattern recognition while keeping gameplay calm and enjoyable. Many players enjoy using word searches to unwind after a busy day.

There is no rush unless you want one. Take your time and enjoy every puzzle, or challenge yourself to finish as quickly as possible. Play your way and set your own pace.

The game is designed for everyone. Children can practice reading and spelling. Teens can sharpen their vocabulary. Adults can relax after work. Seniors can enjoy gentle brain exercise while having fun. Families can even play together and see who finds the most words.

New puzzles and fresh challenges help keep the adventure going. With so many word lists and themes, there is always something different to discover. You can play again and again without running out of fun.

Why players love Word Search:
• Thousands of fun word search puzzles.
• Easy to learn and simple to play.
• Great for kids, adults, and seniors.
• Multiple difficulty levels.
• Fun themed word packs.
• Relaxing gameplay.
• Helpful hints when needed.
• Play online or offline.
• Quick games or long play sessions.
• Smooth controls and clean design.
• Great for improving vocabulary.
• Exercises your brain while you play.
• Perfect for daily play.
• Suitable for beginners and experienced players.

If you enjoy word games, brain games, spelling games, hidden object puzzles, or relaxing puzzle games, this is the perfect choice. Download today and start your next word search adventure. Find hidden words, complete every puzzle, improve your vocabulary, challenge your mind, and enjoy hours of relaxing fun. Your next favorite word search game is ready whenever you are.

release.description:
Undermind is your AI co-researcher for the scientific literature. Ask a research question and Undermind searches the literature for you. It follows citation trails, evaluates hundreds of papers, and comes back with a ranked reading list rather than a page of keyword matches.

With Undermind you can:

- Run deep literature searches. Undermind's search agents explore a research question for a few minutes, then report back with a summary and a ranked list of relevant papers.

- Look up papers by topic, author, title, DOI, or citation relationships (papers citing or cited by a paper you know), with abstracts and citation metrics.

- Ask questions about a paper's full text, including its figures, tables, and equations, and check the answers against the source.

- Keep your work organized in workspaces with folders, starred papers, saved searches, and notes, all synced with your account at undermind.ai.

Scientists at thousands of research institutions use Undermind, from university labs to pharma R&D teams. Use it to check whether an idea is new, get oriented in an unfamiliar field, or track down the one method paper you need.

You'll need an Undermind account (free or paid) and to sign in when connecting.

release.description:
Talk to anyone, anytime, without the pressure.

This app lets you role play conversations with smart AI people so you can practice before real life.

Pick who you want to talk to, choose a situation, and start chatting. Practice a job interview, a first date, a hard talk with a friend, a meeting with your boss, small talk, customer service, school, travel, or almost any other conversation. The AI answers like a real person and keeps the conversation going. You can try again, change your words, and build confidence one chat at a time.

Talking to people is not always easy. Sometimes you do not know what to say. Sometimes you want to practice before an important moment. This app gives you a safe place to learn. There is no need to feel rushed. You can stop, start again, or try a different answer whenever you want. Every conversation is a chance to learn something new.

Choose from many different people and situations. Talk to a friendly coworker, a teacher, a customer, a neighbor, a family member, a hiring manager, a classmate, a travel guide, a doctor, or create your own character. You can make conversations easy, medium, or hard. You decide how the other person acts. They can be kind, serious, funny, shy, calm, excited, or challenging. Every chat feels fresh because the AI responds to what you say.

Practice for real life in a simple way. Get ready for interviews by answering common questions. Rehearse speeches and presentations. Learn how to ask for help. Practice saying no in a kind way. Prepare for school, work, meetings, travel, shopping, or everyday conversations. Try difficult talks before they happen so you feel more ready when the real moment comes.

Learning is easier when you can practice again and again. If you do not like your answer, try another one. See how different words can change the conversation. Explore different paths and discover new ways to communicate. Every practice session helps you become more comfortable speaking with other people.

The app is great for students, professionals, language learners, job seekers, teachers, parents, travelers, and anyone who wants to become a better communicator. Whether you are preparing for something important or simply want to improve your everyday conversation skills, there is always something new to practice.

You can create your own role play ideas too. Type in a situation, describe the person you want to talk with, and let the AI build a conversation just for you. Make fun stories, serious talks, fantasy adventures, business meetings, classroom lessons, or everyday life scenes. The possibilities are almost endless.

The AI listens to what you say and answers naturally. Each conversation changes based on your choices, making every session feel unique. Explore different ideas, ask questions, solve problems together, or simply enjoy a friendly chat. The more you practice, the more comfortable speaking can become.

Simple to use and easy to enjoy, this app is made for anyone who wants to practice conversations in a safe and private space. Open the app, choose a person, start talking, and learn by doing. Build confidence, improve communication, explore new situations, and get ready for real conversations one message at a time. Whether your goal is better social skills, stronger communication, interview success, language practice, or everyday confidence, this app helps you practice, learn, and grow through natural AI role play conversations whenever you are ready.

release.description:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux box, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage systemd services, read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and Linux file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple servers and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit nginx configs, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.

release.description:
Namify turns a spark of an idea into a brandable, available domain — without the back and forth of typing variations into a search bar. Describe your business in plain language, drop in a one-word concept, or paste a seed domain with a preferred extension, and Namify instantly returns relevant name suggestions with live availability across multiple TLDs.

What makes Namify different is that it doesn't stop at "is this domain free?" Every suggestion can be vetted for full brand-readiness: run a trademark check to spot legal conflicts, and a social-handle check to confirm the name is available across major platforms. It is domain discovery built for people who want a name that actually works as a brand — not just a URL that happens to be unregistered.

Best used for naming a new business, side project, app, or product launch — and going from idea to a domain you can register in a single conversation.

release.description:

Connect the apps you already use — LinkedIn, your website, Notion, Gmail, Slack, GitHub — and Unabyss extracts, structures, and keeps your context up to date automatically. Always up to date as your connected sources sync

With minimal input and no complex setup, it turns source content (such as pasted text, files, or conversation context) into structured, high-quality assessment questions.

The app guides users through a single, focused interaction: choose what to assess, select question types and difficulty, and instantly receive a clean, editable set of assessment items. The outputs are presented in a document-like format with copy-ready questions, simple inline editing, and one clear next step: download as a PDF or continue building in Colossyan.

Supported assessment types
*  Multiple Choice (MCQ) - One or more correct answers from a list of options.
* Single Choice - Exactly one correct answer from multiple options.
* True / False - Binary statements evaluated as true or false.

release.description:
Everyone has a Rhythm — a way they like to be talked to.

Rhythm AI Personality Tuner lets you shape ChatGPT's voice to match yours. Five quick cards, fifteen sliders, about a minute: choose how warm or professional it should feel, how direct, how much detail, whether it should challenge your thinking or validate first, hold you accountable or keep things gentle. When you finish, ChatGPT starts speaking your rhythm right there in the conversation — and a before-and-after preview shows you the difference.

Prefer it straight? Your rhythm can say so. Turn down the praise, turn up the pushback, and get answers that tell you what you need to hear — not just what you want to hear.

Your rhythm tunes fifteen dimensions of how ChatGPT communicates, including the ones that matter when a conversation gets personal: emotional awareness, encouragement, and the kind of support you actually want in the moment.

Save your rhythm with a free Rhythm account to keep it. It follows you into new conversations — just @-mention Rhythm to bring it along — and into the Rhythm app, a space to reflect, process, and grow at your own pace. Tune it in either place; it stays in sync.

release.description:
Reclaim.ai  brings intelligent time management directly into ChatGPT, helping you plan, protect, and optimize your schedule

Instead of switching between tools to coordinate meetings and tasks, you can simply ask ChatGPT to organize your time. Reclaim connects to Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, and many popular task platforms and lets you plan your day, schedule meetings, and get things done right from within ChatGPT.

With Reclaim and ChatGPT you can:

- Find the best times to meet based on availability
- Create, update, reschedule, or cancel events
- Quickly focus on your most important tasks
- Show your daily or weekly schedule
- Identify scheduling conflicts and recommend fixes
- Protect time for deep work and important tasks
- Analyze meeting load and focus time
- Help you understand how your time is spent

You stay in control with reviewable changes before updates are applied to your calendar.

Whether you're scheduling meetings, planning focus time, or trying to reduce meeting overload across your team, Reclaim turns ChatGPT into a powerful scheduling and productivity assistant.

Try asking:

“What does my day look like?”
“Find 30 minutes with Alex and Sarah this week.”
“Block two hours for deep work tomorrow morning.”
“What should I work on?”
“Plan my week for focus time.”

Reclaim works with Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Atlassian Jira, Linear, ClickUp, Asana, Todoist, and more.

release.description:
AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.

Unlike traditional email APIs built for one-way notifications, AgentMail is built for two-way conversations: an agent can read an incoming thread, understand it, and respond in context, just like a person would. This makes email a first-class communication and identity channel for agents, letting them sign up for services, coordinate with people, and talk to other agents.

Key capabilities exposed over MCP:
• Inboxes: create, list, get, update, and delete agent inboxes
• Messages: send, reply, forward, list, and update
• Threads: list, read, label, and delete full conversation threads
• Search: full-text search across threads and messages
• Drafts: create, list, read, update, send (with scheduling), and delete
• Attachments: retrieve attachments by ID, with text extraction for PDF/DOCX

Connect in seconds via OAuth using your AgentMail console identity. No API key required in ChatGPT. Sign up free at console.agentmail.to.

release.description:
Pick any color you like and talk about it with AI. 

Tap, drag, or click on the color picker to choose a color. Then ask questions, get ideas, and learn what makes that color special.

There is no right or wrong answer. Just pick a color and start the conversation.

This app makes colors easy to understand. You do not need to know art, design, or color theory. The AI explains things in simple words. Ask why a color feels calm. Ask why two colors look good together. Ask what a color might mean in different places or for different people. The AI helps you learn one step at a time.

Try bright colors, dark colors, soft colors, or bold colors. Move around the picker to see tiny changes. Even a small change can make a color feel very different. Talk about what you see. Ask what changed and why.

Need help choosing colors? The AI can suggest colors that work well together. Explore matching colors, opposite colors, warm colors, cool colors, and balanced color sets. Make palettes for websites, apps, games, logos, posters, drawings, rooms, clothes, or school projects.

Want a happy feeling? A calm feeling? A strong feeling? A fun feeling? Tell the AI what you want. It can suggest colors that fit your idea. You can also show the AI a color you already picked and ask what other colors match it.

Learn about color harmony in a simple way. Find complementary colors that stand out. Explore analogous colors that sit close together. Try triadic colors for a playful look. Build monochromatic palettes from light and dark shades of the same color. The AI explains each idea with easy examples.

Discover what colors can mean. Red can feel exciting. Blue can feel peaceful. Green can remind people of nature. Yellow can feel bright and cheerful. Purple can feel rich or magical. Black can feel bold. White can feel clean. These ideas are common, but they are not rules. The AI can explain different views from around the world.

Working on a design? Ask for ideas for buttons, backgrounds, text, icons, charts, banners, or menus. Building a brand? Explore colors for logos, products, packaging, and marketing. Decorating a room? Compare paint colors and ask how they might look together. Picking clothes? Ask which colors work well for outfits.

If you know color codes, the AI can help with those too. Talk about HEX, RGB, HSL, and other common color formats. Ask how colors change on screens. Learn how brightness, saturation, and hue work. If you are new to these ideas, the AI explains them in plain language.

Accessibility matters. Ask how easy it is to read text on a color. Learn why some color pairs are easier to see than others. Explore better color choices for people with different kinds of color vision. Small changes can make designs easier for everyone to use.

This app is great for students, teachers, artists, designers, developers, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who enjoys colors. You can ask simple questions or deep questions. You can explore for one minute or one hour. Every conversation starts with the color you choose.

Try fun games too. Ask the AI to guess what a color reminds you of. Ask for color trivia. Build a rainbow. Find colors that match the seasons. Explore colors from nature, space, oceans, forests, flowers, food, animals, or famous works of art. Make up stories inspired by colors or invent names for your favorite shades.

There is always something new to discover. Every color has its own story. Every small change creates a new idea. Pick a color, ask a question, and keep exploring. Whether you want to learn, create, compare, imagine, or simply play with colors, this app gives you an easy and friendly way to turn every color into a conversation.

release.description:
Get perfect color ideas in seconds. Ask ChatGPT to suggest colors that work well together, then see them as a simple palette you can use right away. You can keep the colors you like, remove the ones you do not, change any color, or add new ones. The goal is to help you move from an idea to a useful color palette without getting stuck or spending a long time making small choices.

Every suggested color appears as a large color tile that is easy to see. If a color does not fit your project, tap the remove button. Want another idea? Add a new color. Need to fine tune a palette? Change a color instead of starting over. You stay in control while ChatGPT helps you explore new combinations. The result feels fast, simple, and playful, even if you have never worked with color before.

The app is made for anyone. You do not need to know color theory. You do not need to remember color names or search through huge lists. Just describe what you want, let ChatGPT suggest a palette, and make small edits until everything looks right. It works well for beginners, designers, artists, students, teachers, developers, and anyone making something that needs good colors.

A simple editing flow keeps everything easy to understand. Each color is shown as a big square so it is easy to compare with the others. The remove button is always nearby, making it clear how to take a color away. An empty tile with a plus sign lets you add another color whenever you want. Because every action is visible, you always know what to do next.

This makes the app useful for many kinds of projects. Build a brand palette. Pick colors for a website. Try ideas for a mobile app. Match colors for a game. Create art. Plan a room. Design a poster. Choose colors for a presentation. Make social media graphics. Find colors for invitations, stickers, shirts, or school projects. Even if you only want a fun mix of colors to inspire you, the app can help.

ChatGPT can suggest calm colors, bright colors, warm colors, cool colors, playful colors, elegant colors, nature inspired colors, seasonal colors, or almost any style you can describe. If your idea changes, simply ask for another direction and keep editing until the palette feels right. You are never locked into the first answer.

Because the palette is interactive, experimenting is easy. Swap one color instead of replacing everything. Keep your favorite shades while trying new accents. Remove colors that feel too dark, too bright, or too similar. Add another color when the design needs more variety. Small changes can quickly lead to a palette that feels balanced and complete.

The clean layout helps you focus on the colors instead of extra menus or complicated tools. Large color blocks make differences easy to spot. Clear controls reduce confusion. The interface encourages trying new ideas because changing your mind only takes a tap.

The app is also a great way to learn. As you explore different palettes, you naturally see how colors work together. You begin to notice contrast, harmony, and balance without reading long lessons. Every new suggestion is another chance to discover combinations you might never have picked yourself.

Whether you already know exactly what you want or you are starting with nothing but a simple idea, this app helps turn words into color palettes that are easy to edit, easy to understand, and ready for your next creative project. It combines ChatGPT’s ability to generate fresh ideas with a straightforward editing experience, making color selection feel less like work and more like play.

Radio FM is a mobile application for listening to internet radio stations and podcasts from around the world. It provides access to a wide range of audio content, including music, news, talk shows, and entertainment programs.

You can browse and stream radio stations from different countries and explore podcasts across multiple categories and languages.

Multiple genres including classical, rock, pop, hip-hop, instrumental, and more

Browse radio stations by country
Search for specific radio stations or podcasts
Save stations and podcasts to a favorites list
View recently played stations
Sleep timer to automatically stop playback
Alarm feature to start playback at a scheduled time
Access podcasts by category
Simple and easy-to-use interface

release.description:
Basic Memory gives you a persistent knowledge base: your notes, decisions, research, and project context, stored as plain Markdown files you own. Anything your AI saves to Basic Memory, you can open and edit. Anything you write, your AI can find and build on.

Save what matters. "Save our pricing decision and link it to the roadmap." Notes you save in one conversation are available everywhere.

Retrieve context from anywhere. "What did we decide about pricing? Check my notes first." Never re-explain a project.

Search by meaning. Semantic and hybrid search across everything you and your AI have saved.

Structured search. Filter by status, type, tags, or priority. "Show my open tasks, sorted by priority."

Follow connections. Linked notes let your AI traverse related context and surface relationships in a living knowledge graph.

Share a workspace with your team. Teammates and their AI tools read and write to one shared source of truth.

Notes are stored as ordinary Markdown that you own. Any AI tool can use and build on it, so your shared context follows you across the assistants and agents you use.

Subscription Required:

This connector requires a Basic Memory Cloud account (7-day free trial, then from $15/seat/month at https://basicmemory.com.

Use the Basic Memory Cloud app to view and edit your notes at: https://app.basicmemory.com

release.description:
Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.

Use Liner to:

- Search the real-time web and get verified, cited answers
- Summarize PDFs, research papers, and long documents
- Fact-check and verify claims against primary sources
- Find and read academic papers and scholarly research
- Get the latest news and up-to-date information on any topic
- Create market, company, or product briefs
- Compare viewpoints across multiple sources
- Turn a broad question into a structured, cited report

Built for agents and builders: 

Liner works as a grounded search and retrieval layer for AI agents, MCP workflows, and anyone building with real-time information. A reliable alternative to Exa, Tavily, Elicit, SciSpace, and Scite for search, retrieval, and academic discovery.

Liner covers web search, academic search, fact-checking, summarization, PDF reading, paper discovery, real-time news, scraping, and crawling — all with verifiable citations.

Need a fast cited answer or a full report? Liner does both — quick research for speed, deep research when you need more context before a decision. Also available as an API, so teams building AI products can tap the same search and research capabilities directly.

release.description:
Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from ChatGPT. Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries

Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”

release.description:
Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details.

Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available. The underlying imaging and video capabilities are continuously kept up to date so that users can benefit from current state-of-the-art models, improved visual quality, more accurate prompt understanding, better consistency, enhanced realism, and the latest creative generation capabilities.

For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs. This allows users to initiate more complex video-generation tasks without requiring the entire generation process to be completed within a single interaction. After a video job has been submitted, users can retrieve its current generation status through ChatGPT, making it possible to check whether the video is still being processed, has been successfully completed, or requires further action.

Overall, Deep Art AI provides an integrated creative workflow within ChatGPT for generating images and videos, submitting video-generation jobs, and monitoring the progress and status of generated video content. By continuously leveraging the latest available imaging and video technologies, Deep Art AI gives users access to modern, high-quality visual creation capabilities through simple conversational, prompt-based interactions.

release.description:
AI Font pairing for Designers.

Find beautiful font combinations in seconds with AI. Instead of trying dozens of fonts by hand, describe your project and get a complete font trio made for it. Each triplet includes a heading font, an accent font, and a body font that work well together. Whether you are building a website, designing a logo, creating a brand, making a presentation, or working on a social media post, this tool helps you choose fonts with less guesswork and more confidence.

Good typography can make a design feel clean, modern, friendly, bold, elegant, or playful. Picking the right fonts is often one of the hardest parts of design. Many fonts look great on their own but do not look good together. This app helps solve that problem. Tell the AI about your project, your audience, or the feeling you want, and it suggests font triplets that match your goals.

You can ask for styles like minimal, luxury, vintage, futuristic, editorial, corporate, creative, fun, classic, or high-tech. You can also describe your audience, your industry, or your brand personality. The AI uses your ideas to recommend fonts that fit the mood while keeping the design easy to read.

Every recommendation includes three fonts with different jobs. The heading font grabs attention. The accent font adds personality. The body font keeps long text clear and comfortable to read. Together they create a balanced typography system that is easier to use across websites, apps, presentations, posters, packaging, marketing materials, and more.

The app is useful for graphic designers, UI and UX designers, web designers, product designers, marketers, students, content creators, agencies, freelancers, startup founders, and anyone who wants better typography without spending hours testing font combinations.

You can keep asking for new ideas until you find the style you like. Try different moods, industries, audiences, or visual directions. Ask for alternatives, compare different looks, or explore fresh creative ideas. The AI can help you move from rough concepts to polished typography much faster than searching through large font libraries.

Whether you need fonts for a modern landing page, a restaurant menu, a fashion brand, a technology company, a portfolio, a mobile app, a book cover, a newsletter, or an event poster, the app helps you discover combinations that fit the project.

This tool works well during brainstorming, early design exploration, and final design decisions. It can help you avoid common pairing mistakes and give you inspiration when you feel stuck. It is also useful when you want to experiment with styles you might not have considered before.

If you already have one font picked, you can ask for matching options to complete the set. If you only know the feeling you want, the AI can start from that instead. The conversation is flexible, making it easy to refine results until they match your vision.

Instead of spending time comparing endless font lists, start with a strong typography system designed around your project. Save time, discover new ideas, and create designs with more consistency using AI-powered font triplets built for real design work.

release.description:
Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

Build and refine assistants by chat: set the prompt, voice, language, model and call behaviour for both inbound agents (answer calls, take bookings, qualify leads) and outbound agents (follow-ups, reminders, lead qualification). Give them real abilities by attaching mid-call tools that call your APIs live during a conversation, and knowledgebases that ground their answers in your own documents.

Run outbound work at scale: create a campaign, add your leads, and start, pause or resume it whenever you like. Then close the loop — list your calls, open any one to read its full transcript and post-call evaluation, and update the assistant or its tools to fix what went wrong, all in the same conversation.

Manage the rest of your account too: knowledgebases and documents, phone numbers and SIP trunks, WhatsApp senders and templates, conversations, folders, labels and API keys.

You stay in control. Every tool works only on your own account, reading and writing are separate actions, anything that spends balance or deletes data is clearly marked, and your stored secrets are masked. You connect once with a secure sign-in — no API keys pasted into the chat.

release.description:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.

release.description:
Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

interface.long_description:
Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

Works with the forms you already own, not just new ones.

release.description:
Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

Paste any passage into the chat and get a clean, readable version with highlights that open simple explanations beside the text. Instead of jumping between search results, dictionaries, and websites, you stay focused on what you are reading. Tap a highlighted phrase to see why it matters, what it means, or how it fits into the bigger picture.

The app is built for curiosity. Read literature, history, science, news, speeches, legal writing, essays, research papers, blog posts, and your own drafts. Each annotation is created for the specific passage, so the explanations match the surrounding context instead of giving a one-size-fits-all definition.

Highlights can explain:
• Vocabulary and unfamiliar phrases
• Literary devices and writing techniques
• Themes, symbols, and motifs
• Historical and cultural references
• Character development and motivation
• Arguments, evidence, and reasoning
• Tone, mood, and style
• Grammar and sentence structure
• Rhetorical strategies
• Important facts and key ideas

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Open one note at a time to avoid clutter, or move through every annotation in order. Whether you want a quick answer or a deeper explanation, the information is always close to the text that inspired it.

Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Writers and editors can also benefit. Paste your own work into the app to see explanations of structure, language, and rhetorical choices. Use the annotations to spot places where readers may need more context or where a sentence could be clearer.

Every passage is different. A line from Shakespeare needs different notes than a scientific article or a court opinion. The app adapts its explanations to the text instead of forcing every document into the same template.

Designed with a clean interface, the app keeps reading comfortable on phones and tablets. Text is easy to scan, annotations are easy to open, and the layout keeps your place while you explore each note.

Whether you are studying for school, preparing for work, learning a new subject, or reading for fun, the app helps you spend less time searching for explanations and more time understanding what you read. Paste a passage, explore the highlights, and discover more in every paragraph.

You decide how much detail you want. Read straight through without interruptions, or pause on any highlight when something catches your attention. Short notes give fast answers. Longer notes connect ideas across the passage and explain why a sentence, quote, or example matters. This makes it easier to build understanding one step at a time instead of feeling overwhelmed.

The app works well for homework, book clubs, workplace training, language practice, and personal reading goals. If you enjoy asking questions while you read, this app brings those answers directly into the page. It can help you recognize patterns, follow complex arguments, remember important details, and appreciate strong writing.

Features include:
• Paste almost any text
• AI-generated contextual annotations
• Clear highlighted passages
• Simple side-by-side explanations
• Easy navigation between notes
• Clean, distraction-free reading experience
• Fast exploration of complex material

Understanding starts with context. Instead of reading around confusing parts, read through them with guidance that appears exactly where you need it. Read confidently, stay curious, and turn difficult passages into clear learning every day. today.

release.description:
Jam for ChatGPT connects your Jam screen recordings to ChatGPT. When you paste a Jam link, the app pulls in rich debugging context from that recording, including video, user events, console logs, errors, and network requests. ChatGPT can then use this data to help you understand, fix, and organize product issues.

Use Jam for ChatGPT to:
• Explain what went wrong in a recording and why
• Turn a Jam into an engineering ready bug ticket
• Write test cases based on the exact user steps
• Summarize a customer’s experience and impact
• Group similar Jams into themes or issue clusters
• Plan code changes based on real traces, not guesses

How it works:
1. Record an issue or user session with Jam.
2. Copy the Jam link, for example https://jam.dev/c/UUID.
3. In ChatGPT, paste the Jam URL and ask what you want to do, such as:
        •        “Find the root cause of this bug.”
        •        “Write a Jira ticket from this Jam.”
        •        “List clean reproduction steps from this recording.”
        •        “Group these Jam links into related issues.”

Behind the scenes, the Jam app turns your Jam into structured, machine readable data that ChatGPT can work with. You get deep technical context and clear next steps, without retyping steps or relying on users to copy and paste logs.

If you work in engineering, product, QA, or support, Jam for ChatGPT helps you move from “What happened here?” to “Here is exactly what we need to do next.”

release.description:
Pier39 enables a new kind of shopping experience: agent-to-agent commerce.

Instead of manually browsing stores and negotiating with sellers, users can describe what they want and their budget. Pier39 discovers participating negotiate.v1 merchants, finds matching products, opens negotiations with merchant AI sales agents, and works toward the best possible deal on the user's behalf.

The app can:

• Search across participating stores for products matching user intent
• Discover product catalogs and pricing automatically
• Negotiate discounts, bundles, shipping, warranties, and other concessions
• Compare offers across multiple merchants
• Summarize negotiated outcomes and savings opportunities
• Help users make more informed purchasing decisions

Pier39 is built on the negotiate.v1 protocol, an open standard that allows AI shopper agents and AI merchant agents to negotiate without prior integration or coordination.

release.description:
Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Give it a URL and it scans the site against the Vercel Agent Readability Spec, the llms.txt standard, and emerging agent protocols (MCP server cards, A2A agent cards, agents.json), then renders an interactive score card: a 0–100 agent-readability score, an llms.txt score, and a per-check breakdown grouped by site, page, llms.txt, and protocol - each failing check paired with a plain-English fix.

release.description:
The human intelligence layer for AI.

OriginalVoices gives ChatGPT instant access to real human perspectives - so you can ground decisions and AI outputs in what your target audience actually thinks, feels, and values.

Instead of guessing or relying on assumptions, get authentic feedback from real people directly inside ChatGPT. Share ideas, test messaging, validate concepts, or explore what matters to any audience - and use those insights to understand your audience, inform better decisions and create more targeted AI outputs.

With OriginalVoices, you can:
- Define any target audience
- Share anything - questions, links, copy, product concepts, campaign ideas
- Get instant responses from our network of tens of thousands of Digital Twins - AI representations of real people, each owned, trained, and validated by the person they represent

What you can use OriginalVoices for
- OriginalVoices brings real human intelligence into ChatGPT - turning every conversation into an opportunity to understand and act on authentic audience perspectives.
- Test messaging, copy, or creative concepts with your target audience
- Understand what people care about and why it matters to them
- Get feedback on landing pages, product ideas, or campaign strategies
- Create content and ads that resonates with specific audiences
- Compare perspectives across different demographics or segments
- Conduct qualitative research without the wait

How it works
- Tag OriginalVoices in ChatGPT
- Describe your target audience (e.g., "parents of toddlers in the UK," "Gen Z interested in sustainability," "small business owners")
- Share what you want feedback on - a question, a URL, an idea, copy you've written - anything
- OriginalVoices identifies relevant Digital Twins and gathers their responses. Individual perspectives are returned directly in ChatGPT, giving you real human context to inform decisions and shape outputs.
- Get started with the OriginalVoices ChatGPT App today - and bring real human insight into your AI workflows.

release.description:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop

skills.description: Deliverability advisor for the Twilio Email API specifically. For all other deliverability questions — including generic ones — use twilio-sendgrid-deliverability-advisor.

skills.name: twilio-email-send
skills.description: Use when the caller has Twilio credentials (Account SID + Auth Token or API Key SID + Secret) and needs to send email via comms.twilio.com/v1/Emails. This is Twilio-native email — NOT SendGrid. Do NOT use if the caller has a SendGrid API key (SG.-prefix) — use twilio-sendgrid-email-send instead. Covers single sends, batch sends up to 10,000 recipients, Liquid personalization, operation tracking, and error handling.

skills.name: twilio-enterprise-knowledge
skills.description: Add knowledge retrieval to AI agents using Twilio's Enterprise Knowledge product. Enterprise Knowledge is a centralized, searchable repository of your organization's documents, websites, and content — FAQs, support policies, warranty terms, product catalogs. Current models don't have access to how you run your business today. Enterprise Knowledge gives agents a way to query this repository during a conversation and ground their responses in your actual approved source material. This skill covers provisioning a Knowledge Base and uploading knowledge sources from web URLs, PDFs, and raw text, and running semantic search to retrieve relevant chunks at runtime. Enterprise Knowledge is shared across your organization — it captures what your organization knows and how it is meant to run. It is distinct from Conversation Memory (twilio-customer-memory), which is scoped to individual end-customers and captures what you know about a specific person. The two are designed to be combined: enterprise content for business practices, customer memory for personalization.
