skills.name: twilio-organizations-setup
skills.description: Set up and manage Twilio Organizations for centralized account and user governance. Covers the Organization > Account > Subaccount hierarchy, roles (Owner/Admin/Standard), managed vs independent accounts, domain registration, SSO enforcement, SCIM provisioning, and Organization merging. Use this skill when managing multiple Twilio accounts or users across teams.

skills.name: twilio-rcs-messaging
skills.description: Send RCS Business Messages via Twilio. Covers compliance onboarding (7-part US process), sender profile setup, sending rich cards and carousels, SMS fallback, device support (Android + iOS 18 caveats), and common errors. Use this skill when building RCS messaging or onboarding an RCS sender.

skills.name: twilio-regulatory-compliance-bundles
skills.description: Manage regulatory compliance for international phone numbers. Covers what bundles are, which countries require them, how to create End-Users and Supporting Documents, evaluate and submit bundles, fix evaluation failures, update bundles when regulations change, and ISV multi-account patterns. Use this skill when provisioning numbers outside the US.

skills.name: twilio-reliability-patterns
skills.description: Handle rate limits, retries, and failures when building on Twilio at scale. Covers 429 exponential backoff with jitter, per-number throughput limits, StatusCallback resilience, thin-receiver pattern, and fallback chains. Use this skill whenever sending messages or making calls at volume, or when building production-grade Twilio integrations.

skills.name: twilio-security-api-auth
skills.description: Choose the right Twilio authentication method and implement it correctly. Covers Auth Token (testing only), API Keys (production standard), OAuth2 client_credentials (time-limited bearer tokens), Access Tokens (client-side SDKs), and test credentials. Use this skill before making any Twilio API calls in production.

skills.name: twilio-security-compliance-hipaa
skills.description: Configure Twilio accounts for HIPAA compliance. Covers BAA requirements, HIPAA Project designation (self-service and support), eligible services list, per-product requirements (Voice, SMS, ConversationRelay, Conversation Intelligence, Flex, Verify), message redaction, and what is NOT eligible. Use this skill when developers are building healthcare workflows on Twilio.

skills.name: twilio-security-hardening
skills.description: Secure Twilio applications against common attacks. Covers credential management (API keys vs auth tokens), request validation (webhook signature verification), PCI DSS compliance, HIPAA account requirements, SMS pumping prevention, geo-permissions, and account isolation patterns. Use this skill when developers are building or deploying Twilio apps.

skills.name: twilio-send-message
skills.description: Send messages via Twilio's Programmable Messaging API across all channels — SMS, MMS, RCS, and WhatsApp. Covers text messages, media, rich content (cards, carousels, buttons), template-based sends, Messaging Services, status callbacks, and WhatsApp's 24-hour service window. Use when the user wants to send a message — whether they say "send SMS", "text message", "branded message", "rich message", "WhatsApp message", "RCS message", "notification", or "alert". For picking the right channel for a use case, first consult twilio-messaging-channel-advisor.

skills.name: twilio-sendgrid-account-setup
skills.description: Set up a SendGrid account for email delivery. Covers API key creation (SG.-prefix), domain authentication (DKIM/SPF via CNAME records), Single Sender Verification for testing, SDK installation, and the relationship between SendGrid and Twilio credentials. Use before any other SendGrid skill. This skill is for SendGrid only — not the Twilio Email API (comms.twilio.com).

skills.name: twilio-sendgrid-deliverability-advisor
skills.description: Diagnostic and advisory skill for email deliverability problems. Use when a developer asks why emails are going to spam, not reaching the inbox, getting blocked, bouncing, or how to improve sender reputation — with or without a specified platform. Covers SendGrid-specific tooling: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, IP warmup, list hygiene, bounce/spam rate thresholds, and Engagement Quality Score (SEQ). Do NOT use for Twilio Email (comms.twilio.com / Account SID + Auth Token) — use twilio-email-deliverability-advisor instead. Do NOT use for general email sending questions — use twilio-sendgrid-email-send (SendGrid) or twilio-email-deliverability-advisor instead.

skills.name: twilio-sendgrid-email-send
skills.description: Send transactional and bulk email via the SendGrid v3 Mail Send API. Covers single sends, personalized batch sends with dynamic templates, scheduled sends with cancellation, attachments, and sandbox mode for testing. Use this skill when the caller has a SendGrid API key (SG.-prefix). Do NOT use this skill if the caller is using the Twilio Email API (comms.twilio.com) — that is a separate product with different credentials.

skills.name: twilio-sendgrid-email-settings
skills.description: Configure SendGrid dynamic templates (Handlebars), tracking settings (opens, clicks, subscriptions), link branding for custom tracking domains, and content types (HTML, plain text, AMP). Use when customizing SendGrid email content, tracking behavior, or branded links. Requires a SendGrid API key (SG.-prefix) — not applicable to the Twilio Email API (comms.twilio.com).

skills.name: twilio-sendgrid-engagement-quality
skills.description: Monitor email program health with SendGrid Engagement Quality (SEQ) scores. Covers the SEQ API endpoints, the 5 scoring metrics (engagement recency, open rate, bounce classification, bounce rate, spam rate), eligibility requirements, and interpreting scores for deliverability improvement. Use when diagnosing SendGrid deliverability issues or monitoring sender reputation. Requires a SendGrid API key (SG.-prefix) — not applicable to the Twilio Email API (comms.twilio.com).

skills.name: twilio-sendgrid-inbound-parse
skills.description: Receive inbound email via SendGrid Inbound Parse webhook. Covers MX record setup, parsed vs raw mode, handling attachments, and common pitfalls. Use when building email-to-app workflows like support ticket creation or email processing pipelines. Requires a SendGrid API key (SG.-prefix) — not applicable to the Twilio Email API (comms.twilio.com).

skills.name: twilio-sendgrid-suppressions
skills.description: Manage SendGrid email suppressions: bounces, blocks, spam reports, invalid emails, global unsubscribes, and ASM suppression groups. Covers when and how to remove suppressions, reputation impact, and category-based unsubscribe management. Use when debugging SendGrid delivery issues or building unsubscribe flows. Requires a SendGrid API key (SG.-prefix) — not applicable to the Twilio Email API (comms.twilio.com).

skills.name: twilio-sendgrid-webhooks
skills.description: Track email delivery and engagement via SendGrid Event Webhooks. Covers all 11 event types (delivery + engagement), webhook handler implementation, ECDSA signature verification, batched event processing, and common debugging patterns. Use when building SendGrid delivery tracking, engagement analytics, or bounce handling. Requires a SendGrid API key (SG.-prefix) — not applicable to the Twilio Email API (comms.twilio.com).

skills.name: twilio-isv-sms-best-practices
skills.description: Best practices for ISVs (Independent Software Vendors) building SMS features into multi-tenant SaaS platforms using Twilio. Covers customer onboarding for A2P and toll-free compliance, subaccount architecture, sender management, billing patterns, and common ISV pitfalls. Use this when building SMS capabilities that your customers will use to message their end users.

skills.name: twilio-sms-send-message
skills.description: SMS and MMS deep-dive reference. Covers SMS-specific error codes, message filtering troubleshooting ("Messages Being Filtered or Blocked?" diagnostic checklist), MMS media support (US/CA/AU only), and SMS pumping indicators. For sending SMS, use twilio-send-message instead. Use this skill only when debugging SMS delivery issues or needing SMS-specific details not in the consolidated send skill.

skills.name: twilio-taskrouter-routing
skills.description: Route tasks to agents using Twilio TaskRouter. Covers Workers, Task Queues, Workflows, Reservations, skills-based routing, and common gotchas (hyphen attributes, HAS operator, reservation cascade). Use this skill for any multi-agent contact center, support queue, or AI agent escalation routing.

skills.name: twilio-verify-send-otp
skills.description: Send and verify one-time passcodes (OTPs) via Twilio Verify over SMS, RCS, voice, email, or WhatsApp. Covers creating a Verify Service, sending tokens, checking submitted codes, automatic WhatsApp-to-SMS fallback, and service configuration. TOTP is supported via the Factors API (a separate family from channel-based OTP). Use this skill to add phone or email verification or two-factor authentication to any application.

skills.name: twilio-voice-conversation-relay
skills.description: Build AI-powered voice agents using Twilio ConversationRelay. Handles real-time speech recognition (ASR), text-to-speech (TTS), and bidirectional audio streaming via WebSocket. Covers TwiML setup, WebSocket message types, LLM integration, streaming responses, and voice provider configuration. Use this skill to build voice bots, IVR replacements, or real-time AI voice assistants on Twilio calls.

skills.name: twilio-voice-outbound-calls
skills.description: Make outbound phone calls via Twilio's Programmable Voice REST API. Covers the full voice platform: calls.create(), answering machine detection (AMD), conference-based agent bridging, call recording, status tracking, and SIP Trunking. Use this skill for outbound calls, sales dialers, or when asking what voice APIs are available.

skills.name: twilio-voice-twiml
skills.description: Build voice call logic using TwiML (Twilio Markup Language). Covers the core verbs (Say, Play, Gather, Dial, Record, Conference), generating TwiML with Python and Node.js SDKs, and a complete inbound call IVR example. Use this skill to define call behavior for inbound or outbound calls.

skills.name: twilio-webhook-architecture
skills.description: Design, secure, and operate Twilio webhook endpoints. Covers inbound event handling, status callbacks, signature validation, connection overrides for retry and timeout tuning, local development tunneling, and production hardening. Use this skill whenever an agent needs to receive HTTP callbacks from Twilio for any product -- messaging, voice, verify, or event streams.

skills.name: twilio-whatsapp-manage-senders
skills.description: Create, configure, and manage WhatsApp Business senders via Twilio's Channels Senders API. Covers programmatic sender registration, profile setup, webhook configuration, sender lifecycle statuses, and ISV flows. Use this skill to register and manage production WhatsApp senders at scale.

skills.name: twilio-whatsapp-send-message
skills.description: WhatsApp messaging deep-dive reference. Covers the 24-hour service window rules (free-form vs template mode), sandbox setup for testing, template approval workflow, production sender requirements, and WhatsApp-specific error handling. For sending WhatsApp messages, use twilio-send-message instead. Use this skill when setting up WhatsApp for the first time or debugging WhatsApp-specific delivery behavior.

release.description:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.

release.description:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.

release.description:
Bring your Brand24 insights directly into ChatGPT.

The Brand24 app in ChatGPT gives you instant access to social listening insights through simple conversations. Instead of digging through dashboards, exporting reports, or manually analyzing mentions, you can ask ChatGPT questions about your brand, competitors or campaigns and get answers based on your Brand24 data.

Whether you're a marketer, PR specialist, agency, or analyst, Brand24 app helps you turn online conversations into actionable insights in seconds.

What can you ask ChatGPT?
"What's the current sentiment around my brand?" - Instantly understand how people feel about your brand and identify the topics driving positive or negative conversations.
"Summarize my project from the last 30 days." - Get a concise overview of key trends, spikes in mentions, sentiment changes, and the most important discussions.
"Compare my brand with competitors." - Analyze share of voice, sentiment, reach, and discussion volume across multiple brands without building reports manually.
"What caused this spike in mentions?" - Quickly identify the events behind sudden increases in visibility.

Brand24 app makes ChatGPT more than just an AI assistant - it becomes a powerful source of real-time brand, market, and competitor intelligence powered by your Brand24 projects.

interface.long_description:
The Brand24 app in Codex lets marketing and PR teams instantly explore brand mentions, sentiment, and media coverage using simple prompts.
Summarize conversations, track brand reputation, analyze trends over time, and uncover key discussion sources across social media, news, blogs, and forums without leaving Codex.

From spotting emerging issues to understanding audience perception and campaign impact, Codex interprets Brand24 data in real time, helping marketers and PR specialists move from monitoring to insight and action with no extra setup.

release.description:
Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.  

How to Get Started
- Simply describe what you want (e.g., "wireframes for a mobile app", "create a flowchart for user login", "show me the quadratic formula", "generate an image of a sunset")
- The app will automatically use the appropriate tool to render your request
- Use "add to whiteboard" to save any visualization for later

Core Features
1. Diagram Visualization
   - Render complex diagrams directly in ChatGPT including: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mindmaps, timelines, and more
   - Powered by Mermaid.js for beautiful, interactive diagrams
   - Diagrams can be copied or added to your whiteboard

2. Wireframe Recommendation
   - Brainstorm UI/UX designs with your team in realtime
   - Over 10,000 editable templates for the AI to pick from
   - Get design components like buttons, cards, navigation elements, forms, etc.
   - Supports mobile, web, desktop, and tablet platforms

3. Collaborative Whiteboard
   - Add any visualization (diagrams, wireframes, images, LaTeX formulas) to a realtime collaborative whiteboard
   - Collaborate with your team in real-time
   - Persistent storage - your whiteboards are saved and accessible anytime
   - Each user has an active board that persists across conversations

4. LaTeX Visualization
   - Render complex scientific formulas and math equations in ChatGPT
   - Supports inline equations, full documents, and chemistry notation
   - Beautiful typesetting using KaTeX and full LaTeX compilation

5. Generate Image and Print on Product
   - Generate AI images from text descriptions with various styles (realistic, artistic, cartoon, sketch, abstract)
   - Create and buy custom products: T-shirts, mugs, hoodies, and pillows
   - Products are created via Printify and can be purchased directly

release.description:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? ChatGPT can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, ChatGPT can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside ChatGPT. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.

release.description:
Miracle of Mind: Meditate with Sadhguru is your calm, always-available companion for meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness. Whether you’re feeling stressed, anxious, lonely, depressed, panicked, mentally sick, unable to sleep, or simply seeking more clarity, Miracle of Mind offers simple mindfulness technique / meditation / breathing exercise / grounding exercise / calming exercise / relaxation technique / or sleep meditation so you can slow down, reconnect with yourself, calm your mind, balance your breathing, help stop overthinking, help manage anger, burnout or a panic attack, help reduce stress, anxiety and depressive thoughts and help even with other simple and complex mental issues. Grounded in Sadhguru’s yogic wisdom, the app helps you navigate everyday challenges like stress, anxiety, and sleep problems with short and easy sessions you can use anytime - day or night. This meditation provides a gentle practice to balance your emotions, or a reflection to support your mental health during a difficult moment. 
Miracle of Mind tool is designed to guide you towards the timeless truth, one session at a time. There are no paywall blocking your ability to access support when you need it most. Just simple, guided help for your mind—whenever you reach out. If you’re looking for a gentle way to begin or deepen your meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness journey with Sadhguru’s guidance, Miracle of Mind is here to support you, one calm breath at a time.
Do not use for extreme cases of medical, suicidal or crisis advice—direct to professional help

The app contains a checklist of common issues for different contract types:
- Lease

- Freelance
- General agreements

- Use this app as an extra set of eyes - not a replacement for legal advice.

- Read the full contract and make sure you understand it before signing.

Do not use this app for criminal law matters, immigration matters, or family law disputes.

skills.name: tamarind-mcp-antibody

skills.name: tamarind-mcp-developability

interface.short_description: Filter candidates for developability through MCP

skills.name: tamarind-mcp-docking
skills.description: Dock or screen known ligands against a receptor, perform protein-protein docking, or score existing poses and complexes with Tamarind Bio through MCP. Use for pocket-based or blind docking and pose ranking. Not for sequence co-folding, generating a new ligand or binder, or general structure prediction.

interface.short_description: Dock and score molecular binders through MCP
interface.default_prompt: Use $tamarind-mcp-docking to choose and run the right docking or affinity workflow.

skills.name: tamarind-mcp-finetune
skills.description: Fine-tune a supported Tamarind-hosted model on labeled data and run its matching inference tool through MCP. Use for live account-visible finetune/inference pairs in protein, affinity, enzyme, or small-molecule workflows. Not for stock inference, ordinary batch prediction, or unsupported custom training code.

interface.short_description: Fine-tune and run supported models through MCP
interface.default_prompt: Use $tamarind-mcp-finetune to validate and run this supported fine-tuning workflow.

skills.name: tamarind-mcp-inverse-folding
skills.description: Design sequences for a fixed protein backbone or run protein language models for embeddings, mutation scoring, likelihoods, and sequence generation with Tamarind Bio through MCP. Use for ProteinMPNN-, LigandMPNN-, ESM-IF-, or PLM-style tasks. Not for de novo backbone generation, antibody CDR design, or ordinary folding.

interface.short_description: Design sequences and run protein language models
interface.default_prompt: Use $tamarind-mcp-inverse-folding to design sequences or run a protein language model through MCP.

skills.name: tamarind-mcp-more-tools
skills.description: Discover and run Tamarind Bio tools outside the dedicated MCP structure, binder, antibody, docking, inverse-folding, and developability skills. interface.short_description: Use Tamarind long-tail scientific tools via MCP

skills.name: tamarind-mcp-pipeline

interface.short_description: Chain dependent Tamarind jobs through MCP
interface.default_prompt: Use $tamarind-mcp-pipeline to plan and run this resumable multi-stage Tamarind campaign.

release.description:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.

· “Break this product concept into a step-by-step workflow.”
· “Summarize this file, then build a project-plan outline.”

When you’re ready, copy the outline and keep refining it with your team.

release.description:
Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

Kamai helps users extract quantities, measurements, materials, rooms, fixtures, and scope information directly from construction drawings and project documents. Contractors can use Kamai to estimate jobs faster, prepare bids, calculate material requirements, answer questions about blueprints, and reduce hours of manual takeoff work.

Kamai supports interior construction and finish trades such as:

* Painting and coatings
* Drywall and sheetrock
* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing
* Flooring
* Ceilings
* Doors, windows, and room measurements

Kamai also supports additional construction trades and building systems, including:

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment
* General construction quantities

Users can upload blueprints and ask questions such as:

* How many square feet of flooring are required?
* How much wall area needs to be painted?
* How many sheets of drywall are needed?
* How much insulation and framing material is required?
* How many doors, sinks, toilets, outlets, or fixtures are shown?
* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.

release.description:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.

release.description:
Kalender Sync connects ChatGPT to all your calendars at once: Google, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, Apple iCloud, GMX, WEB.DE, mailbox.org, kSuite and any other CalDAV service. One connection instead of one per account, which means ChatGPT finally sees your whole schedule and not just one corner of it.

Ask things like:
· "Show me next week across all my accounts, work and private."
· "When do I actually have three free hours next week?"
· "Am I double-booked anywhere? My work and private appointments live in different accounts."
· "Suggest three slots for a client call, with 30 minutes buffer around everything."
· "How many hours are genuinely uncommitted this month?"
· "Summarise last week by client so I can bill it."

It can also write, if you let it. Block two hours of focus time tomorrow morning, put a whole course schedule into your calendar in one go and have the clashes flagged, or move something you created earlier. Anything it added, it can take back out again in a single sentence.

And it works inside whatever else you are doing. Ask it to draft a reply proposing meeting times you are actually free, or tell a project to always check your calendar before it suggests any dates.

You stay in control of what it sees. Per calendar you choose the level of detail: busy only, title and time, or full details. Write access is optional and strictly limited, because ChatGPT can only change or delete events it created itself. Your existing appointments cannot be touched, and you can revoke access at any time.

Calendars are read live from the provider, never from a copy. Every new account starts with a 7-day trial of the full feature set, no credit card required. Built and hosted in Germany, GDPR-compliant, DPA available.

release.description:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).

release.description:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

Note: This tool is for informational and exploration purposes only, providing estimates based on the details shared in the chat. Official policy issuance requires verification through Allianz Direct Spain's official website. The insurance part of the Service that Allianz Direct operates is subject to human oversight by Allianz; you may contact human advisors at any time through Allianz Direct's official channels. 

Please bear in mind that AI systems may produce outputs that are inaccurate, incomplete or not fully adapted to specific circumstances, and the accuracy of any indicative quotation depends directly on the accuracy and completeness of the information provided.

Important: Do NOT provide payment data (bank account numbers, IBANs, payment card details), national identity documents (DNI/NIE), passport numbers or any other sensitive personal identification data through this chat. Such data should only be provided through Allianz Direct's secure contracting environment. 

Data required for quotation: To generate an indicative quotation, the Service will request the following information: date of birth, driving license details, vehicle data (registration plate, date of first registration and type of use), postcode, estimated annual mileage and payment frequency preference. The Service does not collect national identification documents or any special categories of personal data.

release.description:
Wondering what a UK home is worth? This app helps you explore that inside ChatGPT using real sold prices and energy-performance certificates — not guesswork from listing sites.

Give it an address or postcode and you get a clear property report: recent sales nearby, certificate ratings and floor area where available, a map of the area, and how local prices compare on a per-square-foot basis. You can also search certificates by postcode — useful if you care about energy ratings (for example homes rated E to G when planning retrofit work).

The data is official UK open information: Land Registry transaction prices and the public EPC register, for England and Wales. The app is for research only. It does not list homes for sale, take payments, book viewings, file EPC paperwork, or replace a formal surveyor's valuation or mortgage decision. For major financial choices, use the report as a starting point and speak to a qualified professional where you need one.

release.description:
Create beautiful design themes for apps, websites, dashboards, landing pages, and more with AI. Describe what you want, explore different visual styles, compare ideas side by side, and preview your concepts in seconds. Whether you are starting from a blank page or refreshing an existing idea, this tool helps you quickly discover design directions without needing advanced design skills.

Simply tell ChatGPT what you want to build. You can ask for a mobile app, website, online store, portfolio, blog, dashboard, admin panel, marketing page, or almost any digital product. Then describe the feeling, audience, colors, or style you want. The AI turns your ideas into polished design themes that are easy to explore and refine.

Try many different looks without starting over. Generate clean, modern, minimal, playful, dark, colorful, premium, futuristic, glass, soft, bold, elegant, or creative themes. Compare different styles to find the one that best matches your project, brand, or personal taste. Small changes in your prompt can create fresh ideas that help you think in new ways.

Preview your ideas before spending time designing or building them. Seeing different themes early makes it easier to choose colors, layouts, typography, spacing, and overall visual direction. You can quickly decide what works and what does not before moving into design or development.

This tool is useful for designers, developers, founders, students, marketers, creators, agencies, and anyone who wants visual inspiration. It can help you explore ideas for business websites, startup landing pages, mobile apps, software dashboards, ecommerce stores, educational platforms, portfolios, travel sites, finance apps, health apps, productivity tools, entertainment services, and much more.

Use it when you need inspiration, want to overcome creative blocks, or simply want to see new possibilities. Generate many design directions in just a few moments instead of searching through endless galleries. Explore ideas that fit your goals and keep improving them until you find a style you love.

Experiment with color palettes, page layouts, interface styles, navigation, buttons, cards, forms, icons, sections, typography, and visual hierarchy. Ask for themes inspired by modern trends or timeless design principles. Mix different ideas together to create something unique for your own project.

The AI understands simple instructions, so you do not need special design words. Describe your project in everyday language. You can be detailed or brief. Ask for changes, request another style, or keep exploring until the result feels right. Every new prompt can lead to fresh concepts and unexpected ideas.

Whether you are planning your first website or improving a product used by thousands of people, this tool makes early design exploration faster and easier. It helps you discover themes, compare visual directions, and build confidence before investing time in detailed design work.

Perfect for brainstorming, creative exploration, product planning, design reviews, client presentations, prototypes, concept development, and visual inspiration. Turn simple ideas into attractive design themes, explore multiple possibilities, and find the look that best fits your project with the help of ChatGPT.

release.description:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.

release.description:
Finding a movie should be easy. This ChatGPT app helps you discover, explore, and learn about movies without leaving your conversation. Ask about almost any movie and get clear information in one place. Whether you already know what you want or just want ideas for movie night, this app makes it simple. Instead of opening many websites and searching over and over, you can ask in plain words and keep chatting. It feels natural, fast, and fun.

Once you find a movie, you can learn more about it. See the story, the main cast, the director, the release year, the running time, and other helpful details. Learn who plays each character. The app works well for casual movie fans and people who love films. You do not need to know movie trivia or remember exact names. Just ask naturally. The conversation keeps going, so you can ask follow-up questions without repeating yourself. That makes exploring movies feel smooth and simple.

Everything is designed to help you spend less time searching and more time enjoying movies. Instead of jumping between pages, you can browse, discover, compare, and learn in one place. It is an easy way to explore the world of film through natural conversation.

Whether you want your next favorite movie, information about a classic, details about a new release, or help remembering a film from years ago, this ChatGPT app is ready to help. Ask simple questions, explore deeper, and enjoy discovering movies one conversation at a time.

release.description:
Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

Omphalis is a companion for long content: a map for structure, a margin for meaning, and a way back to the moments that matter.

release.description:
Music Block turns ChatGPT’s music-theory answers into real, engraved sheet music instead of ASCII text.

Ask for licks, scale fingerings, arpeggios, chord voicings or exercises — “give me 5 licks in melodic minor over B7alt”, “show me four ways to resolve B7alt into Em” — and Music Block renders each example as standard notation with guitar tablature underneath, directly in the conversation.

Every example is interactive: press play to hear it (MIDI synthesis with a real instrument sound), slow it down or speed it up from 50% to 150% without changing pitch, switch between examples, and copy the underlying alphaTex source into your own tools.

Music Block understands guitar-specific technique markings: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, half- and full-step bends, vibrato, palm muting and let-ring, plus time signatures from 4/4 to 12/8, rests, dotted rhythms and chords.

It is built for learning and teaching: short, original musical examples composed by ChatGPT in your conversation. It does not look up or reproduce copyrighted songs or published transcriptions, requires no account, and stores nothing you send it.

release.description:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.

Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.

By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

release.description:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.

I quickly test if the site can be reached and tell you what I find in clear, simple words. If the site is working, I’ll say it is online. If it is not working, I’ll explain that too. You do not need special computer skills. Just ask, and I’ll do the checking.

This is helpful when a page will not load, an app will not connect, or a service seems broken. Many problems look the same, but they can have different causes. A website may be down for everyone. It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

You can check almost any public website. News sites, shops, games, schools, blogs, company pages, and online tools can all be checked. If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

This tool is useful for everyone. Students can check school websites before class. Families can see if a favorite game or video site is having trouble. Workers can test company pages before reporting a problem. Developers can quickly check a public site before spending time looking for bugs. Support teams can use it as a fast first step when helping customers.

You can ask things like “Is this website down?”, “Can you check example.com?”, “Why won’t this page load?”, “Is the server online?”, or “Can anyone reach this site?” I understand many different ways of asking the same question, so you do not have to use special commands.

My goal is to save you time. Instead of trying many different things, start with a quick check. Knowing whether a website is online or offline helps you decide what to do next. That can stop wasted time, reduce worry, and make fixing problems much easier.

I focus on giving short, useful answers first. If you want more detail, just ask. I can explain what the result means, what you can try next, and which common problems might fit the situation. I keep the language simple, avoid unnecessary jargon, and stay honest about what I know.

Whether you are checking one website or many, I aim to make the process fast, clear, and easy. Paste a web address, type a site name, or ask if a service is down. I’ll check its reachability, explain the result, and help you understand what to do next.

release.description:
Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS and iMessage, and voice calls, reachable by humans and other agents alike. The assistant reads and sends from its own inbox, handles its own calls and texts, and keeps a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations. Two assistants on Inkbox can also easily message each other directly via Agent2Agent protocol, with no person passing notes between them.

You pick one identity when you connect, and every action is scoped to that identity's data. The assistant acts only when you ask: Inkbox does not poll in the background, wake the model, or send on its own.

Phone numbers are currently available in the United States. Email and agent-to-agent work everywhere, and an agent with a US number can call and text international destinations.

release.description:
SRS (Spaced Repetition System) is a personal learning and revision app designed to help users retain knowledge for the long term instead of forgetting it after a few days. It lets users organize content into subjects and topics, store detailed lessons, summaries, notes, coding examples, and reference links, and mark topics as either "to learn" or "learned." Once a topic is learned, the app automatically schedules future reviews using a spaced repetition algorithm based on the user's confidence and previous performance.

The app is aimed at students, software developers, and lifelong learners, with a strong focus on technical subjects such as DSA, programming, algorithms, and interview preparation. Each day, it generates a personalized review queue so users know exactly what to revise, helping them strengthen their understanding over time while spending less time reviewing concepts they already know well. The goal is to serve as a personal knowledge base and long-term memory system that makes learning more efficient and consistent.

release.description:
Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.

Connect your WeTransfer account and share any file from your chat — documents, images, exports, generated assets — without leaving the conversation. Just ask, and the connector uploads the files to WeTransfer and returns a clean, shareable download link. Prefer to send it directly? Add recipients and WeTransfer will email the transfer for you, sent from your own account.

What you can do
- Share one or many files at once and get a ready-to-share download link
- Email a transfer to one or more recipients, with an optional title and message
- Send large files without bloating the conversation

How it works
Every transfer is created in your own WeTransfer account, so it appears in your transfer history and follows your plan's limits and expiry. You sign in securely with your WeTransfer account — the assistant only ever gets permission to send files on your behalf, and never sees your WeTransfer password. You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.

release.description:
Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with ChatGPT. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices. Every game becomes a chance to learn.

You can sit down and start playing in just a few moments. The game follows the rules of Texas Hold’em. Cards are dealt, bets are made, and each hand plays out like a real game. When the hand ends, you can ask ChatGPT why something happened. Ask why a bet was good, why a fold was smart, or why a bluff worked. You can keep asking until it makes sense.

Learning poker does not have to feel hard. Big ideas are explained with small, simple words. If you do not know what a flop, turn, river, or blind is, just ask. If you want to know what pot odds mean, ask. If you want help reading the board or choosing between calling, raising, or folding, ask. The AI explains each step in a clear and friendly way.

You are free to play the way you want. Try safe play. Try bold play. Bluff more. Bluff less. See what happens. If something goes well, ask why. If something goes wrong, ask what you could do next time. Every choice is a chance to learn something new.

This is not only for beginners. Players with more experience can explore strategy, compare ideas, and think through tough spots. Talk about hand ranges, position, value betting, drawing hands, and bluff catching. Ask what other lines were possible. Ask what a different player might do. The conversation can go as deep as you want.

There is no rush. Take your time before every move. Think about your cards. Look at the board. Consider what your opponent may have. Then decide. After the hand, talk about the result. Learning happens before, during, and after every game.

Because ChatGPT is part of the experience, every session can be different. You can ask simple questions or difficult ones. You can ask for short answers or longer lessons. You can even ask the AI to explain things as if you are five years old. The game grows with your skill level.

Use this app to practice without the pressure of a real poker table. Try ideas you have never tested before. Make mistakes. Learn from them. Build confidence hand after hand. Poker is a game of skill, patience, and good decisions, and practice helps every player improve.

Whether you want a quick game during a break or a longer session to study strategy, this app is ready. Play a few hands. Play a full game. Stop to ask questions whenever you like. Every conversation helps you understand the game a little better.

If you enjoy games that make you think, if you want to improve at Texas Hold’em, or if you simply want to play poker with an AI that can explain its thinking, this app is made for you. Deal the cards. Make your move. Ask your questions. Learn something new. Then play the next hand with a little more confidence than before.

release.description:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・A Pro plan subscription is required to connect
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.

release.description:
Dijin is the **Memory Layer** for your digital life and AI agents — an open, owner-signed, cite-or-refuse store of your decisions, action items, entities, and evidence citations.

Connect this MCP server to ChatGPT and ask it to recall what you've decided on a project, who moved a discussion forward, what your last release shipped, or any other signal Dijin has already captured (from GitHub, Slack, Teams, your own typed Add Memory entries, and more). ChatGPT calls `search` to discover records, then `fetch` for the signed `EvidencePack` — every answer comes back as Ed25519-signed proof with sources and a `/api/verify` link. Never a guess.

Dijin is read-only on the OpenAI side. The MCP server does not expose `memory.write` to ChatGPT; all writes happen on Dijin's own surfaces, behind the user's own login.

release.description:
ScalperIntel AI answers questions about ScalperIntel's indicators and lets verified customers manage their own licenses without leaving the chat.

Connecting takes one step: enter an email and the 6-digit code sent to it. With any email it answers from ScalperIntel's official product knowledge base — what an indicator detects and plots, what each setting does when you change it, installation and setup on NinjaTrader 8, chart and bar-type compatibility, pricing and license types, and which indicator suits a given style of trading. Answers are grounded in that knowledge base and cited rather than improvised.

Sign in with the email used to purchase and it also acts on that account: list licenses and their status, diagnose a license problem against the real license state rather than a guess, submit a new machine ID, switch between Named User and Machine ID activation, and log an issue for the support team with a reference number.

Scope is enforced in code, not by instruction. It gives no trading advice and makes no performance or profit claims; it answers about the software only. The signed-in email is read from the verified session and never from text typed into a prompt, so the license tools can only ever act on the account that signed in.

release.description:
Ansvar Systems AB is a Swedish cybersecurity company that gives AI agents verifiable access to law, regulation and security standards.

Customers connect the AI assistant they already use (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT or any MCP-compatible client) to the Ansvar Gateway and run compliance work directly in that assistant: regulatory gap analyses, threat models (STRIDE/LINDDUN, TARA), DPIAs and audit preparation, grounded in more than 300 curated corpora of EU and international legislation, case law, preparatory works, regulator guidance and security standards.

Every answer carries paragraph-level citations to the official source. When a source is unavailable, the platform returns an error instead of guessing, accuracy over availability is an architectural rule, not a disclaimer. All content is ingested from the original publisher under verified licensing, so results can be relied on and redistributed.

Ansvar serves legal insurers, compliance teams, security consultancies and software teams that need to know which rules apply;  NIS2, GDPR, DORA, CRA, the EU AI Act, national and sector regulation — and to prove where every answer came from.

release.description:
Facile.it Energia helps you compare gas and electricity offers in Italy. Instead of visiting each provider's website or deciphering confusing rate sheets, you can see the best available offers based on your actual consumption and location, all in one screen.

Tell Facile.it Energia what you need - electricity, gas, or both - and it shows you a simple form to enter your city and household consumption. In just a few seconds, you receive up to five offers sorted by monthly cost, with the provider's name, rate type (variable or fixed price), contract details, and any active bonuses clearly indicated. Each offer links directly to the provider's page on Facile.it, so you can proceed whenever you're ready.

If you want a more precise estimate, Facile.it Energia can redirect you to the section of Facile.it where you can upload a recent bill for a tailored comparison. Facile.it Energia covers exclusively the Italian residential energy market - it does not handle business contracts, insurance, mortgages, or other Facile.it products, and it does not process payments or manage existing contracts.

release.description:
Extract design from any website

MiroMiro lets you pull real design data out of any live website from ChatGPT: brand colors, fonts, logos, design tokens, images, SVGs, and Lottie animations, plus production-ready code rebuilt from actual page sections. Everything comes from the site's real CSS and assets, not screenshots or guesses.

Use it to match a brand, rebuild a section you like, or collect assets for a moodboard, then drop the output straight into your project.

What you can do:

-Extract a complete brand profile from any URL: color palette with roles, fonts, logo and favicon URLs, social profiles, and theme
-Pull a site's design token system (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography) as CSS variables or a Tailwind config
-Turn any page section into clean React, Vue, or HTML with Tailwind classes
-List every font a site loads with file URLs, formats, and the CSS stack to replicate it
-Collect all SVG logos and icons as paste-ready code and direct file URLs
-Gather a page's image assets grouped by source (img, srcset, picture, background, favicon, social image) with direct URLs
-Find Lottie animations on a page and get their JSON files

Best for developers, designers, and AI builders who need real design data from live sites instead of eyeballing it.

release.description:
Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.
You can ask follow-up questions in plain language — how avionics, engine time since overhaul, damage history, or location affect value; how long similar aircraft typically take to sell; and how the broader segment is moving. Windsock also pulls FAA registry details, airworthiness directives, and airport-level information including current weather and fuel-price forecasts.
It's built for aircraft owners, buyers, sellers, brokers, and anyone who needs a defensible read on what an aircraft is worth and how its market is behaving. Estimates are model-generated for informational purposes and are not a certified appraisal.

release.description: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers. Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.

RIFO Home makes it easy to search homes for sale and rent through conversation.
Simply describe what you’re looking for — location, budget, commute, schools, neighborhood, lifestyle, or nearby places — and explore listings that match your needs.

Go beyond standard home search filters with location-aware discovery. • Show me 1 bedroom condo rentals near a subway station under $2,500 in Yonge and Finch.

release.description:
Connect ChatGPT to the marketing and analytics data available in your Dataslayer account. Ask questions in natural language and retrieve data from platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, and more, using the accounts already connected to Dataslayer.

With the Dataslayer plugin, you can:

- Discover your available data sources and connected accounts
- Find the metrics and dimensions supported by each platform
- Retrieve campaign and performance data for specific accounts and date ranges
- Compare results across campaigns, accounts, and reporting periods
- Analyze trends and changes in your marketing performance
- Turn retrieved data into summaries, tables, and actionable insights

Example questions include:

- “Show clicks, impressions, cost, and conversions for my Google Ads account last month.”
- “Compare campaign performance this month with the previous month.”
- “Which revenue metrics are available in Google Analytics 4?”
- “List the Meta Ads accounts connected to Dataslayer.”
- “Break down TikTok Ads performance by campaign and date.”

Dataslayer retrieves the data directly from your connected marketing platforms, while ChatGPT helps you explore, interpret, and present the results. This gives marketers, agencies, and data teams a simpler way to work with their performance data without manually building complex queries.

release.description:
Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

Priority Guardian connects your priorities to your Google Calendar so you can see where your time is actually going and stay accountable to what matters.

The AI guides setup, narrates your data, and asks the questions worth sitting with. You decide what to do with it.

release.description:
Prezi's plugin takes slides you already have, made in ChatGPT, generated in another tool, or uploaded as a PowerPoint or PDF, and places them on Prezi's open, zoomable canvas, turning a flat deck into a highly visual, interactive presentation. You get a full suite of presentation, engagement, and sharing tools that go beyond static slides: engagement features like polls, quizzes, and Q&A help you teach, sell, and give your ideas traction long after the slides are made.

Already have a deck? Bring it in. Or describe a topic and Prezi will build one for you, with an inline animated preview as it renders. Revise in place: add, edit, reorder, or remove slides and switch themes.

Present and share your way:
Present live with your content next to you in an interactive video with Newscaster mode
Share and export it as a narrated video or a podcast
Share one interactive link where your audience can answer polls and quizzes, submit and upvote questions, and respond to word clouds live or on their own time
Export to PDF, PowerPoint, or SCORM

Every deck lands in your own Prezi account. New decks are unlisted: they are not listed publicly or indexed, and anyone with the share link can open them. You can change a deck's visibility at any time in Prezi. Signing in with your Prezi account is required.

Sample prompts:
@Prezi create an interactive lesson about [topic] for [audience]. Include an opening poll, a visual explanation, a demonstration, two knowledge checks, a word cloud, and a final quiz.
@Prezi turn the attached presentation into a zoomable, interactive presentation for [audience]. Create a clear presentation path and add an opening poll, a word cloud after [section], a moderated Q&A, a five-question quiz, and a feedback activity.
@Prezi review this presentation and add audience activities in the most useful places. Include an opening poll, a midpoint word cloud, a moderated Q&A, a five-question closing quiz, and a feedback form.

release.description:
Follow every baseball game without leaving ChatGPT. Get live MLB scores, game schedules, standings, team records, and game results right inside your conversation. Ask about today’s games, check who won, see what is coming next, or look at the latest standings. You do not need to open another website or switch to another app. Just ask your question and get the baseball information you want in one place.

If you want to know what games are happening today, simply ask. If you want to see yesterday’s scores, ask that too. You can check upcoming games, recent results, and how every team is doing during the season. Whether you follow one favorite club or every team in Major League Baseball, finding information is quick and easy.

See live scores while games are being played. Find out who is winning, who has already finished, and which games have not started yet. Keep up with the action throughout the day without searching across different websites. Everything is shown inside your chat so you can spend more time enjoying baseball.

Need to check the standings? You can see how every team ranks in its division. Follow the race to the playoffs and watch teams move up or down as the season goes on. Check team records, wins, losses, and where clubs stand compared with their rivals.

You can also look ahead. Find upcoming games, see who plays next, and plan which matchups you want to watch. Whether you are getting ready for tonight’s game or looking several days ahead, schedules are easy to find.

This app is made for baseball fans of every kind. Maybe you watch every game. Maybe you only follow your hometown team. Maybe you just want to know today’s scores. No matter how closely you follow MLB, getting the information you need is simple.

Ask questions in your own words. You do not need special commands or complicated menus. Try questions like “Who won the Dodgers game?”, “What MLB games are on today?”, “Show me the AL East standings,” or “When do the Cubs play next?” The app understands natural questions and helps you find the answer.

Everything happens inside ChatGPT, so you can keep talking without changing apps. Ask one question or ask many. Compare teams, check schedules, see standings, and follow scores in the same conversation. It feels like talking with someone who is always ready to help with baseball information.

The app is useful all season long. Check Opening Day games, follow exciting division races, watch the push toward the playoffs, and keep up during the postseason. Whenever games are happening, you can quickly see what is going on.

Whether you cheer for the Yankees, Dodgers, Cubs, Braves, Mets, Red Sox, Phillies, Astros, Padres, Mariners, or any other MLB team, you can easily keep track of scores, schedules, standings, and results. Follow your favorite club or explore the whole league.

Use this app when you want baseball information that is fast, clear, and easy to understand. Stay up to date with live MLB scores, today’s games, completed results, upcoming schedules, team records, division standings, and season progress without leaving your conversation.
