release.description:
Enable AI-powered credit decisioning, portfolio monitoring, and risk management workflows using trusted D&B data and analytics. 

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com

D&B Finance Analytics empowers finance and credit teams to verify businesses, evaluate financial and predictive risk, accelerate credit decisions, monitor portfolio health, and take action through AI assistants, agents, and enterprise applications. By combining trusted D&B business intelligence, financial risk insights, predictive analytics, and workflow capabilities, organizations can bring credit and portfolio management processes directly into AI-driven workflows. 

Anchored by the global standard D‑U‑N‑S® Number and powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™, D&B Finance Analytics helps organizations reduce ambiguity, improve consistency, and make more confident commercial credit decisions at scale. release.description:
Tawadoo: Buy, Sell & Bid — Morocco's #1 Free Marketplace 🇲🇦

Experience the future of smart shopping with Tawadoo — the ultimate free marketplace to buy, sell, and bid in Morocco. From Casablanca and Rabat to Marrakech, Agadir, Fès, and Tangier, discover thousands of local listings near you. 🎯

Looking for a smarter way to shop or sell? Tawadoo puts the thrill of live auctions and the power of direct negotiation right at your fingertips — whether you're decluttering your home or hunting for that perfect find.

Why Tawadoo?
More than a classifieds app — Tawadoo is an integrated platform that combines the proximity of local markets with competitive auctions and an immersive, social experience built on photos and videos, ensuring transparency and trust in every transaction. 💡

Key Features:
✅ AI-Powered Listings — Our AI automatically generates compelling titles and descriptions to maximise your visibility and search ranking. 🤖
✅ Auto-Translation — Post in French or Arabic; Tawadoo translates your listing into the buyer's language for a seamless experience. 🌍
✅ Photos & Video — HD photos and short videos so buyers see your items from every angle. 📸
✅ 3 Ways to Sell — Fixed price, negotiated offers, or live auctions with real-time bidding. 🤝
✅ Analytics Dashboard — Track listing performance, views, and sales stats in real-time. 📈
✅ Precise Geolocation — Find and sell right in your neighbourhood, from Casablanca to Agadir. 📍
✅ Verified Profiles & Secure Messaging — A trusted community with privacy-first chat. 🔒

Browse Categories:
🔹 Real Estate: Apartments, houses, offices
🔹 Motors: Cars, motorcycles, spare parts
🔹 High-Tech: Smartphones, laptops, electronics
🔹 Fashion: Clothing, jewellery, accessories
🔹 Home & Garden: Furniture, décor, DIY
🔹 Services & Jobs: Job offers and professional services
🔹 Pets: Everything for your companions

Tawadoo Coins: Win & Save! 💰
Boost your experience with Tawadoo Coins. Earn by playing the Daily Lucky Wheel, rating your partners, or referring friends. Buy Coins directly in-app for an instant boost. Use them to feature listings, join auctions as a security deposit, or extend your publication limits.

Security & Compliance 🛡️
Your safety is our top priority. Compliant with Law 09-08 — you have the right to access, rectify, and object to the processing of your data. Authorised by the CNDP under N°A-W-1438/2025.
🔹 Verified Profiles · Secure Messaging · Your data is never sold.

How It Works:
1️⃣ Browse — Explore thousands of local listings across Morocco.
2️⃣ Connect — Chat directly with sellers via secure messaging.
3️⃣ Close — Negotiate and finalise your deal with ease.

Ask Tawadoo on ChatGPT to search Morocco's marketplace, find local deals, and discover listings near you — instantly. 🚀

skills.name: userflow-adoption-agent-topics
skills.description: Read what people actually asked a Userflow Adoption Agent over a time window (default last 30 days) and turn it into a shareable HTML report of plainly-named topics, split into what the agent couldn't answer, what got thumbs-down, and what came up most — every topic expandable to the real conversations behind it. Use this skill whenever a user with the Userflow MCP connected asks "what are people asking the agent", "what are the top topics in the Adoption Agent", "what is the assistant failing to answer", "where is the agent getting negative feedback", "cluster our agent conversations", "analyse Adoption Agent questions", "what are the knowledge gaps in our agent", "summarise AI assistant conversations", or wants any topic, theme, cluster, gap, or failure analysis of an Adoption Agent / AI Assistant / assistant flow. Also trigger when a picker widget from this skill sends a prompt like "Build the Adoption Agent topic report for ... over ...". Requires the Userflow MCP connector.

interface.short_description: Find agent topics, gaps, and negative feedback
interface.default_prompt: Use $userflow-adoption-agent-topics to analyze our Adoption Agent conversations from the last 30 days.

skills.name: userflow-flow-segment-compare
skills.description: Compare how a single piece of Userflow content performs across several audience segments, rendered as a dashboard — a key-metrics comparison table plus trend charts. Works for ANY Userflow flow type (guide flows, announcements, banners, checklists, launchers, resource centers, embeds), not just flows and announcements. Content is chosen from a searchable dropdown; the "segments" are whatever the user wants to compare — existing account segments, ad-hoc filters built just for this analysis, or a mix — and ad-hoc ones are never saved to the account. Use whenever a user with the Userflow MCP connected wants to "compare a flow/announcement/banner across segments", "how does [content] perform for [group A] vs [group B]", "break down [content] by audience/user type", or any per-audience performance breakdown of one piece of content. Different from userflow-flow-compare (two flows head-to-head) — here it's ONE piece of content across MANY audiences. Requires the Userflow MCP connector.

interface.default_prompt: Use $userflow-flow-segment-compare to compare one Userflow flow across several audience segments.

skills.name: userflow-banner-creator
skills.description: Create an in-app banner in Userflow through a guided, conversational flow — gather context from a short summary, pasted content, attached file, public page, or linked document/ticket in a connected app; draft and refine short banner copy; add an optional CTA; configure placement and behavior; optionally target users; show a confirmation card; create an unpublished draft through Userflow MCP; return the Builder link; and offer to publish. Use whenever a user with Userflow MCP connected asks to create or add an in-app banner, announce maintenance, a promotion, or an update in a page-top or page-bottom bar, or turn a note, ticket, or document into a Userflow banner. Requires the Userflow MCP connector.

interface.short_description: Draft, review, and publish in-app banners
interface.default_prompt: Use $userflow-banner-creator to create an in-app banner from my announcement.

skills.name: userflow-segment-creator
skills.description: Create a condition (filter-based) segment in Userflow through a guided, conversational flow — pick user vs. company, describe the audience in plain language, translate it into real attribute/event predicates (looked up, never invented), show the conditions in a simple inline card for confirmation, name it, and create it via the Userflow MCP. Use this whenever a user with the Userflow MCP connected wants to "create a segment", "build an audience", "make a user/company segment", "segment users who…", "define a group of users/companies by conditions", or filter their audience by attributes or behavior. Requires the Userflow MCP connector. Note — the MCP only creates condition segments; manual/list (CSV-uploaded) segments are not supported and must be imported from the Userflow dashboard.

interface.default_prompt: Use $userflow-segment-creator to create a condition-based Userflow segment from my audience description.

skills.name: userflow-flow-compare

release.description:
Din Bostad helps users search the Swedish real estate market from inside ChatGPT. Use it for any prompt about finding, searching or browsing Swedish properties for sale: apartments (lägenheter, bostadsrätter), houses (villor, hus), townhouses (radhus), cabins (stugor), plots (tomter), or any for-sale property in Sweden.

The assistant resolves place names the user mentions to specific administrative locations (län, kommun,
area, place, street), then queries the listings index with structured filters such as price range, property
type, room count, living area, plot area, facilities (pool, balcony, garage, fireplace), energy class, viewing
windows, nearby points of interest (water, parks, schools, transit), publication recency, and sort order.
Constraints from earlier turns are carried forward, so users can refine or change direction without
restating everything.

Matching for-sale listings render on an interactive map widget with a sidebar list and a fullscreen
inspector for individual properties. Each listing links to the full advert on dinbostad.se, where the user can see all photos and viewing times, book a viewing, or contact the agent.

energiklass C eller bättre", "Radhus under 5 miljoner i Helsingborg och Lund, minst 4 rum", "Hus nära
vatten i Bohuslän med pool", "Three-bedroom villas in Malmö under 8 million SEK", "Cabins for sale in
Värmland", "Newest listings in Umeå".

release.description:
No Bike No Life beantwortet Motorradfragen mit Daten aus dem NBNL-Katalog.

Wetter: Mehrtägige Vorhersage mit Fahrbarkeits-Bewertung, Zustand der Alpenpässe und ein Kompass, der zeigt, in welche Himmelsrichtung sich die Ausfahrt heute lohnt.

Anfängerwissen: Über 200 beantwortete Einsteigerfragen zu Technik, Wartung und Fahrpraxis.

Alle Angaben stammen aus dem redaktionell gepflegten Katalog von nbnl.de. Modellfotos sind Herstellermaterial und mit Quelle gekennzeichnet.

release.description:
Atlas AI Agent brings your Atlas workspace into ChatGPT, with three assistants in one place.

Ask for a briefing and the executive assistant reads your connected mailbox and calendar to tell you what needs attention today, what decisions are pending, and what you're still waiting on. Ask about sales and you get live pipeline figures, your leads ranked by score across campaigns, and a personalised outreach email drafted for whichever lead you name. Ask about marketing and you get channel performance, everything in the content queue with its status, whatever is sitting in your approvals, and new post drafts on request.

Nothing is sent or published from ChatGPT. Outreach emails and social posts come back as drafts you approve inside Atlas, so the assistant can never speak to a customer on your behalf without you seeing it first.

Connecting is a normal sign-in, and permissions are granted per assistant: you can give ChatGPT your marketing without handing over your inbox, and disconnect any time from Atlas under Connected apps.

release.description:
Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.

release.description:
Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.

Getting started

Type @ and pick Kenso from the menu to start your message — that is what pulls Kenso into the conversation. Without it, ChatGPT answers from its own memory instead of your training data.

• @Kenso show me today's workout
• @Kenso what should I train today?
• @Kenso log my workout: bench press 3x8 at 80kg, rows 3x10 at 60kg
• @Kenso pull up Upper A so I can log it — shows a card you fill in set by set
• @Kenso how is my bench trending?
• @Kenso am I training chest enough?

Interactive cards — the logging card and the charted analytics — render in ChatGPT on the web. On mobile you get the same answers as text.

You will see Kenso appear in the chat when it is really being used. If an answer arrives without it, say "check Kenso".

Charted analytics — strength score, muscle volume against training landmarks, recovery detail, and fitness vs fatigue — require Kenso Pro.

release.description:
Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result carries a link back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action on your behalf. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.

skills.name: category-monitor
skills.description: Monitors one Mercado Livre (Brasil) category's aggregate health via JoomPulse — estimated sales, number of products and catalog products, active sellers, the seller-medal distribution, and the monopolization level. Each run builds today's snapshot table and offers it for download; to see what changed, the user sends a table from a previous period and the skill shows the metric-by-metric difference. The baseline is whatever table the user supplies — no hidden session memory. Triggers: "monitor this category", "what changed in this category", "track category sales and sellers", and the pt-BR "monitorar esta categoria", "o que mudou na categoria", "comparar a categoria com o período anterior". Sales and revenue are JoomPulse estimates, not real transactions. To track one named product over time use the product-change-monitor skill; for a one-shot market-size or opportunity snapshot use the category-opportunity-index skill.

Use it when a seller wants a one-shot market snapshot for a category they name. Triggers include: "is this category worth entering", "show the opportunity index for this category", "how big is this market", and the pt-BR equivalents "qual o índice de oportunidade", "vale a pena entrar nessa categoria", "tamanho de mercado da categoria". skills.name: my-product-vs-catalog
skills.description: Compares the seller's own Mercado Livre listing against the available competing listings of the same catalog product — the buy-box competition — and says where they win, lose, and what to fix first. Use it when a seller asks why they don't win the buy-box, why they don't sell despite the same product, or how they rank inside a catalog, given a Mercado Livre or JoomPulse link or a listing or catalog product identifier. It scores each parameter — price, free shipping, Full, listing type, seller reputation, official store — as Melhor, Na média, Pior, or Criticamente pior, presents reviews and rating as context, and returns a verdict, a comparison table, prioritized actions, and a spreadsheet. For a product and its competitors, use the single-product analysis skill; for one over time, the change-monitor skill.

release.description:
Create beautiful color gradients with plain English.

This GPT helps you design, improve, explore, and refine gradients for websites, apps, logos, presentations, social posts, games, illustrations, and anything else that uses color. You do not need to know color theory or CSS. Just describe what you want, and it will help you create gradients that fit your idea.

You can ask for soft, bold, bright, dark, warm, cool, modern, vintage, playful, elegant, natural, futuristic, or minimal styles. You can start with one color, two colors, a mood, a brand, or even a simple sentence. The GPT turns your idea into well-balanced gradient suggestions and explains why they work in clear, simple language.

It can create linear, radial, and other common gradient styles. If you already have colors, it can improve them. If you only have an idea, it can suggest colors from scratch. If something feels “off,” it can recommend small changes that make the whole design look better.

This GPT is useful for designers, developers, marketers, students, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who wants better-looking colors without spending hours experimenting.

You can ask for things like:

• A sunset gradient for a landing page.
• A modern blue gradient for a SaaS product.
• A calm background for a meditation app.
• A colorful gaming theme.
• A luxury black and gold look.
• A pastel gradient for invitations.
• A nature-inspired palette.
• A dark mode background.
• A hero section gradient.
• A gradient based on your company colors.

If you are building a website, the GPT can suggest gradients that feel clean, readable, and professional. If you are making an app, it can recommend combinations that support the style you want. If you are creating marketing graphics, it can generate eye-catching backgrounds without overwhelming your content.

It can also explain why certain colors work together, how warm and cool colors change the mood, and how contrast affects readability. The explanations are simple enough for beginners while still being useful for experienced creators.

Need inspiration? Ask for dozens of ideas. Want something unique? Ask for unexpected combinations. Want something safe? Ask for classic choices. The GPT adapts to your goals instead of giving the same answers every time.

You can refine results by saying things like “make it brighter,” “less purple,” “more premium,” “more playful,” “higher contrast,” “better for dark mode,” or “closer to nature.” Each request builds on the last so you can quickly explore different directions.

Developers can ask for CSS gradients or color values. Designers can focus on appearance. Beginners can simply describe what they imagine without worrying about technical details.

This GPT works well for websites, mobile apps, dashboards, presentations, posters, logos, illustrations, social media graphics, game interfaces, email banners, portfolios, branding, product mockups, wallpapers, and digital art.

Whether you need one quick gradient or want to explore many creative directions, this GPT helps you move from idea to polished result in minutes. Describe the feeling, purpose, audience, or colors you have in mind, and receive thoughtful gradient suggestions that are easy to understand, easy to refine, and ready to use in your next project.

release.description:
Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector
lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

Every result deep-links back to tripuck.com for booking review and
checkout. The connector itself is read-only — it does not book, charge,
modify accounts, or hold any user payment information.

Supported user languages: Turkish, English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, German,
Georgian, and Uzbek. The tool infers the user's language from the
conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.

release.description:
Turn what you're learning into a quiz you can actually play.

Paste a short note, add fuller notes, name a subject, share a supported public webpage, or ask ChatGPT to use relevant text it can read from an attached file. Trivana Study creates one unlisted 5-, 7-, or 10-question practice quiz with automatic scoring, an AI host, and a play link for you or your study group.

Short note seeds may be supplemented with verified, well-established subject knowledge so there is enough material for a complete round. Fuller notes and supported webpages remain grounded in the supplied source. If you ask to use only the supplied material, Study keeps that strict boundary and may ask for more material.

Answer a warm-up in ChatGPT, then open the full quiz—players need no account. Sofia hosts by default, or choose from 8 personalities in 10 supported languages. If Save & track scores appears, you can claim the quiz and keep plays, scores, and replays.

Unlisted means anyone with the link can play, but the quiz is not automatically featured publicly. For attached files, ChatGPT may send extracted or condensed text; Trivana does not receive the raw attachment. Built for lecture review, class revision, exam and certification practice, and quick checks of what actually stuck.

release.description:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.

release.description:
LIAM is a personal memory assistant. It saves and recalls the facts, preferences, and notes you want to keep across conversations; stores and searches your contacts; keeps multi-step recipes and routines; and logs your meals and receipts with daily nutrition and spending summaries. You can type a request or just upload a photo — a receipt, a meal, a business card, or a note — and LIAM reads it and files it in the right place automatically (a restaurant receipt is logged as both an expense and a meal). Only extracted text/values are stored, never the raw image.
Example use cases
"Remember I prefer window seats on flights — tag it 'travel'."
"Who do I know at Nova Retail?" / "Add Sarah Chen from Acme as a contact."
"Log my lunch: chicken caesar salad" → "How much protein did I have today?"
"Log this receipt: Loblaws $87.43 groceries" → "How much did I spend today?"
Upload a business-card photo → contact created; upload a receipt photo → expense + meal logged.

release.description:
Get NHL scores, schedules, standings, team details, player information, and game updates without leaving your chat. This app brings hockey information right into your conversation. Ask a question in plain English and get a clear answer. You do not need to search many websites or open another app. Everything stays in one place, making it fast and easy to follow the NHL.

Want today’s scores? Just ask. Want tonight’s games? Ask that too. Need the latest standings? The app can show them. You can check team records, player stats, game times, and much more. If you want to know who won, who is playing next, or how your favorite team is doing, simply ask.

The app works like a hockey helper. You can ask short questions or longer ones. You can say things like “Who plays tonight?”, “Did the Oilers win?”, “Show me the Eastern Conference standings,” or “When do the Rangers play next?” The app understands natural language, so you do not have to learn special commands.

Follow one team or every team. Keep up with the regular season, the playoffs, and important games. Find schedules, scores, and standings in seconds. Whether you watch every game or only check in once in a while, the information is easy to find.

Player information is also simple to explore. Ask about a player and learn which team they play for, their position, and other useful details. Compare players, check team matchups, or look up game information before the puck drops.

Need a quick answer during a game? Ask for the live score. Want to know what happened after the game ends? Ask for the final score. Looking ahead? Check upcoming games and schedules. Looking back? Review recent results. The app helps you stay connected all season long.

Everything happens inside your conversation. There is no need to jump between tabs or search through many pages. Just ask another question and keep going. It feels like talking with a friend who always knows what is happening around the NHL.

The app is built to be clear and easy to use. Answers are organized so they are simple to read. Whether you ask one question or many, the goal is to help you find hockey information quickly.

Great for longtime fans. Great for new fans. Great for people learning about hockey. If you know every player, you can dive into detailed information. If you are just starting to watch the NHL, you can ask basic questions and learn as you go.

Use the app to check scores before work, during lunch, after school, or before bed. See who is winning, who is climbing the standings, and what games are coming next. Keep track of your favorite team throughout the season without extra searching.

You can ask about today’s games, tomorrow’s games, team records, conference standings, division standings, schedules, results, matchups, and more. The app is made to help you find hockey information in a simple and friendly way.

Whether you want a fast score check, a full schedule, the latest standings, player information, or answers to everyday NHL questions, this app keeps everything together inside ChatGPT. Ask, explore, and stay up to date with the National Hockey League from one easy conversation.

release.description:
Structured decision-making using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) , a proven framework for comparing options and resolving trade-offs.

Whether you're evaluating cars, comparing job offers, choosing a vendor, or weighing any set of alternatives, decisionpoint.io guides you through the process step by step. You define the goal, identify the factors that matter, list your options, and then compare them two at a time. AHP derives ranked results from your comparisons, showing which option best matches your priorities and why.

The app provides:
- A visual overview of your decision structure
- An interactive comparison interface within the conversation
- Ranked results with scores and criteria weights
- Consistency analysis to identify contradictory judgments

Decisions are saved to your decisionpoint.io account and can be revisited, refined, or continued at any time.

release.description:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. A STACK-branded approval screen lets you choose exactly which capabilities to grant, and you can allow read-only work (finding and reviewing) without allowing changes. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.

release.description:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.

release.description:
Trabber is a travel metasearch engine. Search for a flight, a place to stay or a rental car, and you get the current prices from the airline, travel agency, hotel and car rental websites that sell it, side by side, plus a direct link to book the one you pick on that seller's own website.

Why that helps: the identical trip can cost quite different amounts depending on where you buy it, and the cheapest seller changes from one route or property to the next. Checking by hand means a dozen browser tabs. Here you ask once.

What you can search:

- Flights, one way, return or multi-city.

- Accommodation of any kind: hotels, apartments, aparthotels, hostels, guest houses, villas, campgrounds.

- Rental cars.

- Flight deals, for when you have no destination or dates in mind yet.

Narrow any search down by asking: direct flights only, morning departures, breakfast and free cancellation, automatic with unlimited mileage. Connect your Trabber account and you can pick your recent searches back up.

Trabber doesn't sell travel. You book, pay and get support on the seller's website, under their terms.

release.description:
SKW Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialised in the Gütersloh region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in Gütersloh and the surrounding area.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand a property's location, nearby infrastructure, and surroundings at a glance, making the property search significantly easier and more efficient.

With in-depth local market knowledge and personalised service, SKW Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with regional expertise to help buyers, sellers, and investors navigate the Gütersloh real estate market.

Key Benefits

* Interactive map-based property search
* Faster orientation in Gütersloh and the surrounding region
* Better understanding of locations, infrastructure, and surroundings
* Focus on selected residential and investment properties in the region
* Easy comparison of different towns and communities
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
* Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for an apartment in Gütersloh, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, SKW Immobilien offers a modern and transparent way to explore the regional real estate market.

release.description: ApexLog is a track day logbook for drivers. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your own driving history in plain language: compare two laps sector by sector, see where you lost time, pull the setup and tyre state you ran at an event, check how many laps are on a set of pads or tyres, or read the GPS trace of your best lap — including OBD channels such as fuel and temperatures when they were logged. It holds the full context around your laps — vehicle, tyre model and age, per-session setup, component wear, weather and track — so the assistant answers with your real data. The connector is read-only and scoped to your own account; it never changes or deletes anything. You bring your own ChatGPT plan, so there are no question limits.

release.description:
Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

This app helps business owners write clear, personal, and polite replies to customer reviews. Copy a review, paste it into the app, and get a response that sounds friendly and professional. Save time, keep your customers happy, and build a better online reputation without staring at a blank page.

Good review? Bad review? Short review? Long review? This app can help. It creates thoughtful replies that fit the customer’s message instead of giving the same answer every time. You stay in control and can edit every reply before you post it.

Customers notice when businesses reply. A simple thank you can make a good review even better. A calm and caring answer to a bad review can show that you listen and want to help. Taking time to reply builds trust, but writing every response can take hours. This app does the hard part for you.

The app is made for busy business owners, managers, and teams. It works well for restaurants, cafés, shops, hotels, plumbers, electricians, salons, gyms, dentists, doctors, real estate agents, law firms, cleaners, contractors, and many other businesses. If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

Replying to reviews can help your business grow. People often read reviews before they choose where to spend their money. When they see helpful replies from the owner, they know someone is paying attention. That can build confidence and encourage more people to visit, call, or buy.

The app is easy to use. Paste a review, choose the style you want, and generate a reply in seconds. There is no need to search for templates or wonder what to say. The app helps you find the right words quickly.

Use it for positive reviews, negative reviews, five-star reviews, one-star reviews, first-time customers, regular customers, complaints, compliments, questions, and everything in between. Every review is different, and every reply should feel personal.

Keep your brand voice consistent. Whether your business is fun, formal, warm, or simple, you can create replies that match your style. This helps customers recognize your business and builds a stronger connection over time.

The app also helps reduce stress. Many business owners worry about saying the wrong thing, especially when responding to unhappy customers. Instead of starting from scratch, you get a thoughtful draft that you can review and adjust before posting.

Fast replies can make a big difference. Customers like knowing they have been heard. A quick response shows that your business cares about feedback and wants to improve. Even a short reply can leave a lasting impression.

Whether you receive a few reviews each month or many every day, this app helps you stay on top of them. Save time, reply with confidence, and give every customer the attention they deserve. Better conversations lead to better relationships, stronger trust, and a better reputation. Start writing smarter review replies today and spend less time typing while making every customer feel heard.

skills.name: intelligo-compare-reports

Use this skill whenever the user wants to compare, diff, or cross-reference Intelligo reports or profiles — including "what changed since the last report", "refresh comparison", "compare this profile's new and old report", "what's common between these two profiles", "do these subjects share anything", or comparing every profile in an Intelligo project against each other. Trigger on phrases like "compare reports", "what's new in this refresh", "diff these profiles", "shared connections between profiles", "what did the upgrade add", "compare the two report levels", and on any request that names two or more Intelligo profiles/reports and asks how they relate. release.description:
Amok gives ChatGPT direct access to Cambodia's banking, fintech, and technology regulation — as verbatim evidence from official sources, never paraphrased.

Ask about bank licensing and prudential rules, technology risk management, liquidity risk, payment systems and Bakong, AML/CFT, or fintech policy. Amok searches a corpus built from Cambodia's official sources — the National Bank of Cambodia's laws, prakas, and guidelines, and the Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia — and returns the exact provisions: precise Article citations, current validity, and an official source link on every result so you can verify the original wording yourself. When something is missing from the corpus, Amok says so instead of guessing.

The corpus is in English. Ask in any language — ChatGPT translates and answers grounded in the official text. Results support research and compliance work; they are not a substitute for legal counsel. Free, no account needed.

Meet Hero, your AI teammate for Sales. Hero can join your calls, write your follow-ups, research accounts, and help you keep every deal moving. This connector provides ChatGPT read-only access to your Hero data so you can get Hero’s insights wherever you work best. 

What you can do in ChatGPT with the Hero connector
• Search meeting transcripts by keyword, meaning, date range, or workspace to  pull the full transcript with per-speaker segments.
• Find and read Hero-generated artifacts like call summaries, account research, saved notes, and uploaded files.
• Browse and revisit your Hero conversation threads.
• Get a list of your Workspaces (accounts and deals) to scope your work. 

Example prompts
• “Summarize my calls with Acme this month, and draft a follow-up email.”
• “Can you tell me what objections came up during yesterday’s demo with Hooli?” 
• “Pull the account research Hero wrote for Globex and turn it into a one-pager.”
• “Find every call where pricing came up this quarter.”

Security and Privacy
• Sign in with secure OAuth: no passwords or API keys to manage.
• Strictly read-only: ChatGPT can retrieve your Hero data but cannot create, modify, or delete anything.
• Scoped to your own account: ChatGPT only sees data you already have access to in Hero
• Requires a Hero account: get started at meethero.ai.

release.description:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.

release.description:
Temponia is a time-tracking and timesheet app for freelancers, agencies, and in-house teams who want their hours logged without it feeling like a chore.

Instead of a long list of empty fields, Temponia gives you a calendar view: drag to log hours the way you'd block out a meeting. Connect Google Calendar or Outlook and turn existing events into billable entries in a click. Native iOS and Android apps keep your week up to date when you're away from your desk.

What you can do with it:
  - Log time on a calendar, list, or timer, whichever fits the moment
  - Track tasks and projects with groupable dashboards by week, month, or year
  - Manage expenses alongside hours in one place
  - Sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO; provision teams via SCIM/JIT
  - Export clean timesheets and reports for clients or payroll
  
Good for solo consultants tracking billable hours, agencies invoicing clients, and teams that need a tidy record of where the week went.

Tell Chaiz your car by VIN, license plate, or make, model, and year, plus your mileage and state, and it pulls live quotes from multiple trusted providers so you can compare real prices, coverage, and independent plan ratings side by side. Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search

release.description:
Metz Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialising in Frankfurt am Main and the surrounding region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in one of Germany's most dynamic economic regions.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available apartments, houses, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. With in-depth market knowledge and personalised guidance, Metz Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with regional expertise to help buyers, sellers, and investors navigate the Frankfurt real estate market with confidence.

* Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
* Faster orientation in Frankfurt am Main and the surrounding region
* Better understanding of locations, infrastructure, and neighbourhoods
* Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
* Easier comparison of different districts and residential areas
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct access to experienced real estate professionals

Whether you're looking for a condominium in the heart of Frankfurt, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, Metz Immobilien provides a modern and transparent way to explore the real estate market in Frankfurt am Main and the surrounding region.

release.description:

All trail data is open (CC-BY-4.0) and read-only — the app stores no personal data. Place data comes from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata; the trail route is published by the Stockholm Archipelago Trail under CC-BY-4.0.

release.description:
SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

Give it a list in Hebrew and a delivery address. It matches each item to real products in each chain's catalogue, adds delivery fees where the chain publishes verified terms, and returns a per-store total with a per-item breakdown, plus a link to each product on the retailer's own site.

It is built not to guess. Items a store does not carry are marked missing rather than swapped silently, every price carries the date it was last seen in the chain's price file, and a delivery fee is quoted only when the chain publishes terms that have been verified. When several products match one line, it asks you instead of picking for you.

Prices come from the price files Israeli retailers publish under the Price Transparency Law, ingested nightly.

Coverage is Israeli online supermarket delivery, and the product catalogue is in Hebrew.

release.description:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery").
Results carry page URLs, and get_doc returns any page as plain markdown for
reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All six tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and no
storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a service name. Nothing is
retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.

release.description:
Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.

Ask for a resort and a month, and you get a daily crowd score from 1 to 10
with the predicted wait-time level for each date — across Disneyland Paris,
Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.

release.description:
The Tessun Immobilien app makes property searching in Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley clearer and more locally focused.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can see available properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easier to quickly understand which location best fits their daily life — whether in Munich, Wolfratshausen, Geretsried, or the surrounding areas.

Faster geographic orientation
Users can immediately see where a property is located and what the surrounding area looks like.

Better understanding of the location
Especially in regions like Munich or the Isar-Loisach Valley, the micro-location is often crucial. The map view helps users better evaluate distances, infrastructure, and the surrounding environment realistically.

Focus on relevant regional properties
Instead of thousands of random listings, the app focuses on selected properties from a regionally specialized real estate agency.

Easier comparison of different locations
Users can directly recognize how residential areas differ — for example, between urban Munich and quieter surrounding towns.

Less time wasted on unsuitable listings

release.description:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32. Federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently maintained PSL Tax-Calculator, and state results reproduce to the cent against OpenTaxSolver across California, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts. That proof recomputes live in your browser at optionsahoy.com/verification.

This matters because language models are confident and wrong at exactly this task. In a published benchmark, five frontier models were given the same multi-year ISO problem, three runs each. All five overstated the after-tax value of their own proposed schedules, by 1.6x to 17.6x against the provable optimum. One model claimed $3.9M, $5.2M, and $13.0M on three runs of identical input. The prompt and full transcripts are public at optionsahoy.com/benchmark. The arithmetic here is deterministic instead: the same inputs on the same date give the same answer every time, with no model inference anywhere in the number.

Free, no account, no API key, and your figures are not retained. United States tax logic only. This is a planning calculator, not tax advice.

release.description:
The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.

The MCP server exposes structured tools that allow AI assistants to understand, author, validate, and work with Opscotch applications and workflows.

The server is designed for developers using AI coding assistants, and automation engineers who want to build or maintain Opscotch solutions using natural language.

An AI connected to the server can perform tasks such as:
- answer questions about the Opscotch platform
- explain APIs, configuration, and runtime behaviour
- author workflows and bootstrap configurations
- validate workflow structure and configuration
- assist with packaging, deployment, and licensing
- provide guidance using the latest platform capabilities
- generate examples and implementation patterns

With MCP, the AI can use purpose-built tools that understand the Opscotch platform, resulting in responses that are:

- more accurate
- aware of current platform features
- capable of structured authoring rather than just producing text
- less prone to hallucinating APIs or configuration

Typical use cases
- "Create a workflow that polls an HTTP endpoint every minute."
- "Why won't this bootstrap validate?"
- "Generate a workflow that receives webhooks and forwards them to AWS SQS."
- "Explain this JavaScript processor."
- "Help migrate this workflow to the latest Opscotch version."
- "Help me generate a signed package for deployment."

The server is intended for:

- AI coding assistants
- IDE integrations
- CLI agents
- automation developers
- DevOps and platform engineers
- custom AI applications that need authoritative knowledge of Opscotch

release.description:
Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

At its core, Quotient is an AI demand marketing platform. It brings everything that attracts customers: blogs, social posts, email, webinars and events, and brand-building, into one integrated workspace. You work with Quotient like a coworker. Describe what you want in plain English, and it takes it from there.

Campaigns organize your marketing around a central goal, like a feature launch or event. Each is a coordinated set of tasks and deliverables moving through a clear workflow. Deliverables are the real assets Quotient creates and ships: blog posts, email broadcasts, marketing events, automated flows, and social posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Ask Quotient to build a campaign end to end: it writes the brief, breaks the work into tasks, sets the timeline, and produces each deliverable.

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.

The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.

release.description:
Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.

Connect it and you can work with your own shelf in plain language. Ask what you have not worn since spring and it reads your collection. Say you wore the Santal 33 decant today, four sprays, and it logs the wearing and deducts the millilitres. Add a bottle you just bought in a sentence instead of a form, correct a rating or a note on one you already have, group bottles onto shelves, and save the layering combos you actually wear.

It also prices your wishlist. Ask for the best price on something you are saving for and Fraghab searches fragrance retailers for the cheapest current offer, tells you which shop has it, and gives the entry a product photo.

You authorize the connection on a Fraghab screen and approve each permission. Nothing can be deleted through it. Editing replaces what was there, so ChatGPT asks before it changes something you already had. Changing your Fraghab password revokes access immediately. Fraghab is free and takes no payment of any kind.

release.description: Your site just broke — ask SiteTriage why. Give it a URL or domain and it runs live, read-only diagnostics from the edge: DNS resolution and propagation, the exact TLS certificate the server is presenting right now (including TLS 1.3), HTTP status and redirect chains, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and domain registration and expiry. It then returns the most likely root cause, ranked, with concrete fix steps — instead of guesses. Ideal for the deploy moment: apex-vs-www misconfigurations, stale DNS after a host migration, propagation lag, certificate errors, redirect loops, and emails landing in spam. Stateless and anonymous: no accounts, no stored data.

release.description:
Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP supports AI-driven sales, marketing, and revenue operations by providing GenAI-ready data, analytics, and insights to inform go-to-market execution. It brings together firmographic, ownership, relationship, and market datasets into a unified intelligence layer to help teams identify opportunities, prioritize accounts, and support more effective customer engagement. 
 
The solution combines comprehensive Moody’s entity intelligence, including global company profiles, hierarchies, and ownership linkages, with augmented signals such as news, market activity, and risk indicators. This integrated view helps organizations gain additional visibility into total addressable markets, identify whitespace opportunities, and align sales and marketing strategies around high-value prospects. 
 
By bringing together structured company data and contextual insights into a single interface, Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP helps streamline data-to-insight workflows and supports improvements in targeting precision, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes. 
 
Data includes: 
- Global company firmographics and identifiers 
- Corporate hierarchies and ownership structures 
- Industry classifications and segmentation 
- Financial indicators and company scale metrics 
- News, market signals, and company events 
- Risk indicators and early warning signals 
- Economic data and research 

 Use Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP for: 
- GTM Planning – define and size target markets with comprehensive company coverage  
- Account Prioritization – identify and prioritize high-value prospects and customers and support more sophisticated opportunity scoring by combining company-level data with market-level indicators. 
- Territory Design – support geographic and account planning by highlighting industries, regions or countries with stronger growth prospects 
- Pipeline Acceleration – surface in-market signals and help support timely engagement based on macroeconomic trends, investment activity, hiring trends or sector-level forecasts 
- Cross-Sell & Upsell – help identify whitespace within existing customer portfolios and support AI-generated account briefs that incorporate industry outlooks, economic scenarios, and strategic talking points 
- CRM Enrichment – enrich account and lead records with company data and insights 
- Marketing Segmentation – develop data-driven audience segments using company, market, and relationship insights

release.description:
Alizé is a legal database and search engine for law professionals. With this connector, your assistant answers from the real documents instead of from memory, and gives you a citation you can open and check.

It searches the same corpus the Alizé platform runs on: more than 20 million documents across some 250 collections, ingested from the official publishers and updated daily. Coverage is fully developed for Luxembourg, Belgium, Spain and the European Union, alongside partial coverage of France and international law. Collections are complete rather than sampled, consolidated rather than scattered, and tracked for in-force status document by document.

Your assistant does the thinking. Alizé gives it the real law to think on.

You need an Alizé account and your firm's existing subscription. You reach the same collections you already have in Alizé, and nothing more. The connector reaches Alizé's legal databases only, so it never sees your own files.

release.description:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation ChatGPT can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, ChatGPT points you to Beamtrace's setup page instead of guessing at your data. 

It doesn't change your Beamtrace settings, tracked prompts, or account data. It reads your dashboard and hands the numbers to ChatGPT for analysis, reporting, and Q&A.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to view a property's location, nearby infrastructure, and surrounding neighborhood at a glance, making the property search process simpler and more efficient.

With extensive local market expertise and personalized advice, Lott Immobilien combines innovative digital solutions with many years of experience in the regional real estate market.

Key Benefits
Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
Faster navigation across the region from Leer through Augustfehn to Oldenburg
Better understanding of property locations, infrastructure, and neighborhoods
Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties in the region
Easier comparison of different cities and municipalities
More efficient property searches through visual navigation
Direct access to experienced real estate professionals
Modern, user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a detached family home in Leer, a condominium in Oldenburg, a property in Augustfehn, or an attractive investment opportunity in the region, Lott Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and convenient way to access the regional real estate market.

release.description:
OpenRegs brings current U.S. statutes and regulations into ChatGPT for compliance teams. Coverage spans 53 jurisdictions: all 50 states, D.C., Puerto Rico, and federal. Every answer returns the actual text of the law, along with a research log and public citation links that anyone can open, so a colleague or an auditor can check the work rather than take a summary on faith. Run a 50-state survey in one request instead of maintaining a spreadsheet by hand. Built by OpenLaws PBC, the public benefit corporation behind the OpenLaws API. OpenLaws is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

Use cases:
- Confirm a citation is real and still in force, then read its current text.
- Compare how a rule differs across multiple states in one request.
- Research a regulatory topic across U.S. statutes and regulations, with a research log and citations you can verify.

skills.name: citation-validator
skills.description: Validate or read a SINGLE U.S. statutory or regulatory citation the user names — confirm it resolves to real, in-force law and return the official text with a clickable provenance link. This is the free OpenRegs capability: one named citation in, verified text out. The trigger is a specific citation in hand: use this skill, in preference to the research assistant, whenever the user names one to check or read (e.g. "is Tex. Lab. Code § 411.103 real?", "is 29 U.S.C. § 201 still good law?", "pull Cal. Lab. Code § 512"). It does NOT search by topic, compare jurisdictions, or do open research — when the user names no specific citation and needs law found, compared, or explored, that is the research assistant's job, and this skill points there.

skills.name: surveyor
skills.description: Research U.S. codified law — statutes, regulations, and constitutional provisions, federal or any jurisdiction OpenLaws covers — when the user needs law FOUND, COMPARED, or EXPLORED rather than a citation they already hold read back. Covers topic questions ("what does [state] law say about..."), multi-jurisdiction surveys, and open-ended research where the user does NOT name a specific citation. ALSO take questions about court decisions, controlling cases, holdings, or precedent: case law is outside the corpus, so claim them and decline with discipline — name the boundary, cite the governing statute, point to case-law sources — rather than leave them to an unverified answer. Same for pending rule changes or past-date rules. If the user hands you one named citation to confirm or read back, that is citation-validator's job. Ground every claim in the OpenRegs MCP tools FIRST (never training data; web only via the official-source exception), produce a research log, and refuse when a claim can't be grounded.

release.description:
Get accurate, citable answers about Shallon CSP (the trading name of Shallon Legal FZ LLC), a UAE-based legal, corporate, and fiduciary services provider based in Fujairah that serves clients across Europe and international markets. Courtyard AI operates this connector for Shallon CSP with the firm's explicit authorization and keeps its content current automatically, so answers come from the firm's own published information rather than stale third-party sources.

Use it for full details on the firm's practice areas: company formation and corporate administration; corporate services (ongoing governance, compliance, and corporate housekeeping); DIFC and ADGM wills, trusts, and foundations for expatriates in the UAE; cross-border structuring; dispute resolution; legal drafting and documentation; and regulatory compliance and licensing. It also covers who the firm serves, its office hours and logistics in Fujairah, and accessibility information.

The connector exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a canonical source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text, its canonical URL, and metadata. Every result resolves to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded and citable to source.

All content is public business information describing the firm's services. It is general information, not legal advice. No account, login, or personal data is required, and no client data is exposed. The connector is strictly read-only: it retrieves and cites the firm's published information and never performs writes, bookings, or transactions.

release.description:
Autumn lets hotel operators ask about their property's performance, pricing, bookings, and marketing — and get answers straight from their own data.

Once you connect your Autumn account, you can ask things like:
- "How is occupancy for next month compared to last year?"
- "What are my ADR and RevPAR this quarter?"
- "Which room types look underpriced right now?"
- "Who were my top-spending guests last month?"
- "How did my Google Ads perform last week?"

Autumn pulls live data from your property management system (Mews, Cloudbeds, or ResNexus), your rate plans, your Google Ads account, and review sites like Google, Booking.com, and Expedia — so the answers reflect what's actually happening at your property today.

All tools are read-only. Autumn does not change rates, modify bookings, or write anything back to your PMS.

Requires an active Autumn subscription. You'll authorize access to your Autumn workspace via OAuth on first use.

release.description:
InsightfulPipe is a marketing workspace that connects ChatGPT to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social media, and e-commerce platforms your business already uses. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, create reports, and perform supported actions without manually exporting and combining spreadsheets.

Paid advertising: Connect Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, and X Ads. Analyze spend, campaign performance, conversions, and other available metrics. You can also conduct competitor research using supported public advertising libraries.

SEO and site health: Access Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and DataForSEO for search performance, SERPs, keyword rankings, and backlinks. Additional tools include website crawling, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Tag Manager.

Analytics: Retrieve insights from Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, and YouTube Analytics.

Social media and scheduling: Analyze connected Instagram accounts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages and profiles, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and WordPress. Supported connections can also schedule, publish, and reschedule content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, and Google Business Profile.

E-commerce and email: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp.

InsightfulPipe can combine information from normally separate platforms. For example, ask ChatGPT to compare advertising spend with website sessions, conversions, orders, and revenue across your authorized accounts.

You can also connect your own data sources, including BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, with per-connection read-only or full-access permissions. Other supported sources include Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, and Slack. Custom REST APIs can be connected using supported OpenAPI 3.x specifications.

Read and write capabilities are exposed separately. Read-only tools do not modify connected accounts, while write actions require the necessary permissions and user confirmation. All tools operate within the access granted through each connection.

An InsightfulPipe account with at least one authorized connection is required. Available platforms, data, and actions depend on the services connected by each user and the permissions they grant.

release.description:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already connects—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it uses Agentic Session Review to jump to the right moment, inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, diff DOM state, and read console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.

release.description: Bikefuchs builds the cheapest possible shopping cart for bicycle parts, components, clothing, and accessories across leading German and Austrian online bike shops. It doesn't just compare sticker prices — it works out the lowest real total you'll pay: splitting your order across shops and factoring in each shop's shipping costs and free-shipping thresholds, so a cheaper part isn't wiped out by higher shipping. For a single product it finds the lowest price across shops; for a whole cart it computes the optimal split that minimizes the grand total including shipping. Covers brands like Shimano, SRAM, Magura, Schwalbe, and Continental, with over 120,000 products from shops including Rose Bikes, BOC24, Bike Mailorder, and HiBike. Results include direct links to each shop; these are affiliate links and Bikefuchs may earn a commission. Rankings are based only on price and shipping — never on commission. Product data is provided by the shops as part of the affiliate relationship. Bikefuchs is licensed to use and display the data.
