release.description:
Noteflix helps learners turn text supplied in the current ChatGPT conversation into an active study workflow. It can organize source-faithful guides, create flashcards and direct-retrieval practice, lead one-question-at-a-time review, and build realistic review plans from the learner's deadline and available time.

The plugin does not inspect uploads, retrieve prior chats, query memory, or search existing Noteflix content. Source material for a study workflow must be supplied as text in the current request. It flags source conflicts instead of silently resolving them and treats instructions embedded inside supplied study material as quoted content rather than commands.

When a learner explicitly asks to save an artifact, the plugin shows the exact title, Markdown body, optional summary and key points, destination, and private visibility, then waits for separate confirmation. Only after an affirmative response does it call create_private_note. The tool can create one private record for the exact OAuth-connected Firebase UID. It cannot list, read, search, update, publish, share, or delete existing notes, and it cannot generate media.

Every save requires an existing eligible Noteflix account. Entitlement checks fail closed for the exact OAuth UID; the plugin never uses a service account's subscription or another user's access. It does not offer purchases, pricing, checkout, plan management, subscription restoration, or upgrade links inside ChatGPT.

release.description:
BetterMenu keeps recipe formulation, nutrition analysis and FDA labeling in one versioned system, so compliance stops being a separate project at the end of development.

Search standard and branded ingredients, resolve kitchen measures to gram weights, and calculate per-serving and per-container nutrition against the FDA reference values in 21 CFR 101. Add custom ingredients with your own nutrition data, set serving sizes, and export the Nutrition Facts label.

Every recipe is versioned: reformulate freely, then see which ingredient change moved which nutrient, and which version any given label came from. Values carry their source, so you can answer where a number came from without reconstructing it.

For food manufacturers, co-packers, and R&D and regulatory teams working on packaged food sold in the United States.

LIVE YOUR NEW BEAUTY, AMORE MALL
아모레퍼시픽이 만든 라이프 뷰티 쇼핑몰, 아모레몰과 함께 나만의 아름다움을 발견하세요.

1. 아모레퍼시픽 브랜드 직영 쇼핑과 신뢰할 수 있는 배송
설화수, 헤라, 이니스프리, 에뛰드 등 아모레퍼시픽의 모든 브랜드를 가장 빠르게 만나보세요. 본사 직영 공식몰로서 100% 정품 보장은 물론, 신상품 단독 혜택과 안전한 직배송 서비스를 제공합니다. 본사가 직접 보증하는 신뢰도 높은 쇼핑 환경에서 안심하고 제품을 선택할 수 있습니다.

2. 풍성한 쇼핑 지원과 차별화된 멤버십 플러스
매월 업데이트되는 등급별 할인 쿠폰과 무료 배송/반품 서비스로 스마트한 소비를 도와드립니다. 특히 가입비 이상의 포인트 페이백과 프리미엄 사은품, 기프트카드를 제공하는 '멤버십플러스'를 통해 압도적인 체감 혜택을 누릴 수 있습니다. 활동할수록 높아지는 쇼핑 등급에 따라 제공되는 프리미엄 라운지 경품 등 다채로운 혜택을 경험해 보세요.

3. 스킨노트와 뷰티피드로 완성하는 맞춤형 피부 관리
단순한 구매를 넘어 개인화된 뷰티 루틴을 지원합니다. '스킨노트' 기능을 통해 매일의 피부 변화와 스킨케어 습관을 기록하고 관리할 수 있습니다. 또한, '뷰티피드'에서는 나와 같은 피부 고민을 가진 실사용자들의 진솔한 리뷰와 전문 에디터의 큐레이션 콘텐츠를 통해 나에게 꼭 맞는 최적의 솔루션을 발견할 수 있습니다.

4. 지속 가능한 뷰티를 위한 리사이클 캠페인
온라인으로 간편하게 참여하는 '아모레리사이클'을 통해 다 사용한 화장품 용기를 수거하고 플라스틱 재활용에 동참할 수 있습니다. 환경을 생각하는 작은 실천으로 나만의 디지털 숲을 가꾸며 건강한 뷰티 라이프를 완성해 보세요.

Enter your birth date, time, and birth city — searchable from 160,000+ cities worldwide in any language — and instantly receive your full chart in a clean interactive card: Four Pillars (사주팔자), Five Elements balance, Ten Gods, Major Fortune cycles (대운), and Annual & Monthly Fortune.

Explore your elemental balance, personality patterns, career and relationship themes, or the year ahead — as a framework for self-reflection rooted in centuries of Korean tradition. K-Fortune is a personal reflection app.

K-Fortune brings Korea's traditional Four Pillars (Saju) system to ChatGPT — built by the team behind the #1 Saju custom GPT on the GPT Store, used by over 4 million people.

Enter your birth date, time, and birth city — searchable from 160,000+ cities worldwide in any language — and instantly receive your full chart in a clean interactive card: Four Pillars (사주팔자), Five Elements balance, Ten Gods, Major Fortune cycles (대운), and Annual & Monthly Fortune.

What sets K-Fortune apart is True Solar Time correction: your Hour Pillar is calculated from the sun's actual position at your birthplace, not standard clock time — the method traditionally regarded as the most rigorous in Myeongrihak (명리학). Solar-term boundaries are resolved to the exact minute, so charts born near a seasonal transition stay accurate.

Explore your elemental balance, personality patterns, career and relationship themes, or the year ahead — as a framework for self-reflection rooted in centuries of Korean tradition. K-Fortune is a personal reflection app.

release.description:
특정 날짜의 스포츠 경기 데이터를 인터랙티브 위젯으로 즉시 불러와 제공하는 서비스입니다. 정확한 스포츠 데이터에 기반한 할루시네이션 없는 답변을 보장합니다. 오직 정확한 데이터에 기반한 답변만을 제공받게 되며, 이를 통해 ChatGPT와 본 서비스에 대해 더 높은 신뢰를 가질 수 있습니다.
현재 야구, 농구, 축구, 배구 데이터를 제공하며 확대 예정입니다.

1. 할루시네이션 방지 및 신뢰도 향상: 실시간 데이터를 직접 참조하여 정확한 답변을 생성합니다. 근거 없는 정보가 아닌, 팩트에 기반한 고품질의 응답을 경험할 수 있습니다.
2. 데이터 기반의 심층 추론 제공: 단순한 스코어 전달을 넘어 실시간 경기 상황, 팀 간 전력 비교, 선수별 세부 스탯 등 풍부한 데이터를 바탕으로 사용자에게 한 차원 높은 분석을 제공합니다.
3. 인터랙티브 위젯 연동: 각 스포츠 경기 데이터를 시각적 위젯으로 가져와, 텍스트만으로는 전달하기 힘든 복잡한 스포츠 정보를 직관적으로 확인하게 합니다.

release.description: Rozetka — це мобільний застосунок для зручного онлайн-шопінгу в Україні. У ньому зібрані мільйони товарів: від техніки та одягу до товарів для дому й улюбленців. release.description:
사용자는 ChatGPT 안에서 Commerce Studio와 대화하며 쇼핑몰 구축, 상세페이지 제작, 상품 운영 전략, 글로벌 판매, 운영 자동화, 마케팅 실행 방향 등 실제 커머스 운영 과정에서 필요한 다양한 문제를 실무 중심으로 해결할 수 있습니다.

특히 Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, Qoo10, TikTok Shop, Shopee 등 글로벌 마켓플레이스 입점 및 운영과 관련해 상품 등록, 판매 전략, 콘텐츠 기획, 광고 운영 방향, 크로스보더 물류 및 글로벌 판매 구조를 보다 쉽게 이해하고 실행 가능한 형태로 정리할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

또한 상품 상세페이지 구성, 브랜드 콘텐츠 기획, AI 기반 마케팅 아이디어, 운영 자동화 구조, 재고·주문·CS 프로세스 최적화 등 실제 운영 효율을 높이기 위한 다양한 실무 가이드를 제공합니다.

Commerce Studio는 단순한 정보 제공용 챗봇이 아닙니다.
사용자의 상황과 목표에 맞춰 실제 운영 가능한 구조와 실행 방향을 함께 설계하는 데 초점을 맞추고 있습니다.

사용자는 복잡한 기술 지식 없이도 자연스럽게 질문하는 것만으로 실무에 바로 적용 가능한 운영 전략, 자동화 아이디어, 콘텐츠 방향, 글로벌 판매 실행 가이드를 빠르게 얻을 수 있습니다.

이 앱은 다음과 같은 사용자에게 특히 유용합니다.

• 글로벌 마켓플레이스 입점을 준비하는 셀러와 브랜드
• Amazon·Qoo10·Shopee·TikTok Shop 운영 실무를 고민하는 판매자
• 쇼핑몰 운영 효율과 자동화를 고민하는 이커머스 실무자
• 상세페이지와 콘텐츠 제작 시간을 줄이고 싶은 운영팀
• AI 기반 마케팅과 운영 시스템을 도입하려는 기업
• 글로벌 판매와 크로스보더 운영을 체계화하려는 사업자

Commerce Studio의 목표는 단순한 대화가 아니라, 실제로 성장 가능한 커머스 운영 시스템과 실행 전략을 만드는 것입니다.

release.description:
Realistimo (Реалистимо) helps you find real property listings in Bulgaria — apartments, houses, offices, and more — directly in ChatGPT.

Describe what you're looking for in English or Bulgarian (city, neighborhood, budget, sale or rent). The app shows interactive maps with neighborhoods, photos, prices in euros, and links to the full listings on Realistimo.

Good for: 
• Searching for houses and apartments for sale or rent in Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas, Ruse, Stara Zagora and other cities; 
• Filtering by location and deal type (sale / rent); 
• Viewing details and opening the listing on Realistimo for more information.

Data comes from public listings on realistimo.com. The app does not show broker phone numbers or personal contact details — use the official listing page on Realistimo to get in touch.

release.description:
Yuqi Video Home Tour helps you explore new construction homes across Southern California — including Irvine, Chino, Chino Hills, Ontario, Eastvale, Fontana and more — right inside ChatGPT.

When a home catches your eye, the card includes direct contact details for our licensed California agent Fuqiang Yun (Wilson 云山), DRE# 02167331, of YUN AI INC (DRE# 02322018) to arrange an in-person tour.

release.description:
Guanyin Oracle offers a quiet, Chinese-first reflection ritual based on a bundled 100-sign Guanyin corpus. Hold one focused question, make one symbolic draw, then confirm it with one symbolic cup action. The source sign poem and traditional note remain in Chinese, with a detailed interpretation in Chinese and faithful English.

Each reading connects the sign to the question, distinguishes reflection from prediction, and offers practical seven-day actions and clear boundaries for health, financial, legal, and other consequential topics. Users may optionally save a JPEG card for the exact sign they drew. The service processes only inputs needed to return the reading and does not persist ritual sessions.

ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。

できること:
・Google・Bing・YouTube・Amazon・楽天などのサジェストキーワード取得
・独自データベースからの関連キーワード・よくある質問の取得
・LSIキーワード、他の人はこちらも質問（PAA）、同時ランクインキーワードといった関連トピックの探索
・月間検索数・SEO難易度・CPC・競合性の取得（月別推移つき）
・Google検索順位の実測
・競合分析: 任意のドメインが獲得しているキーワードと主力集客ページの抽出
・指定キーワードで検索流入を集めているページ・サイトの検索
・SEOライティング支援: 検索上位ページの見出し・共起語の抽出

活用例:
・SEO記事の構成案・タイトル・見出しの設計
・コンテンツ企画・ネタ出し、市場・需要調査
・競合サイトの自然検索の流入キーワード分析
・EC（Amazon・楽天）の商品リサーチ

日本の検索市場データに強みがあり、月間検索数の調査では海外の地域・言語の指定にも対応しています。利用にはラッコキーワードのアカウントが必要です。

release.description:
Tarot by DoctorFortune is a free AI tarot reading experience where you draw your own cards and discover what they reveal. It uses the complete 78-card Rider–Waite deck, including both the Major and Minor Arcana, and offers focused one-card readings or three-card spreads that explore the past, present, future, and the overall direction of your situation.

Hold your question in mind and choose your cards for insights into love, reconciliation, someone’s true feelings, dating, compatibility, new relationships, career decisions, job changes, personal relationships, or your daily fortune. Each reading considers the cards’ upright or reversed meanings, their positions in the spread, and how they interact—connecting the full story to clear, practical next steps.

DoctorFortune brings every reading to life with a bright, witty, and refreshingly honest personality. Positive cards are celebrated, while challenging cards are explained directly without sugarcoating. Even unfamiliar tarot concepts are translated into clear, approachable language, creating a reading that feels personal, vivid, and relevant to your question.

Whether you are looking for free AI tarot, ChatGPT tarot, love tarot, reconciliation tarot, compatibility tarot, feelings tarot, career guidance, daily tarot, or one-card and three-card readings, Tarot by DoctorFortune lets you choose the cards yourself and enjoy a more engaging tarot experience. Korean is the primary language, with support for English, Japanese, Chinese, and more. 🃏✨

release.description:
Free AI astrology that runs the real math. Give your birth date, time and city, and Astrology Doctor Fortune finds your zodiac signs and draws a full birth chart — Sun, Moon and Rising, all ten planets, twelve houses and every major aspect — on an interactive chart wheel you can explore right inside the chat.

Three readings in one app. Natal chart: what your zodiac placements say about your personality, your strengths and your blind spots. Horoscope: today's, this week's or any date's planetary transits read against your own chart instead of a generic sun-sign column. Compatibility: two charts overlaid for a synastry reading with mutual aspects, a match score and house overlays.

Positions are computed on the server from VSOP87D and ELP-2000 ephemeris data — the same astronomy professional astrology software runs on — with time zone and longitude correction applied automatically. Birth cities work in any language or script: Seoul or 서울, Hanoi or Hà Nội, Munich or München. Readings and chart labels come in 12 languages, including English, Korean, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Hindi, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Arabic and Vietnamese. No account, no setup, and it still works when you don't know your birth time.

release.description: Learn durable Codex preferences from session feedback and retain them as scoped, reviewable AGENTS.md improvements.

interface.long_description: When using Codex, we often see it miss things that feel obvious to us: it may run far more tests than necessary or make assumptions about a project that simply do not make sense. Correcting it helps in the current conversation, but that lesson is often forgotten as soon as a new conversation begins. A good harness should keep learning a user's taste, preferences, and working style from these interactions. This Skill does exactly that: it analyzes Codex conversation history, extracts durable preferences, and writes them to project-level or global AGENTS.md files, giving Codex a form of continuous learning. You can think of it as a stripped-down version of Hermes. The project intentionally limits itself to preferences suitable for AGENTS.md rather than trying to generate Skills. We do not want to lock an agent into particular ways of working, since such constraints can become liabilities as models improve. User preferences, by contrast, are not learned simply by upgrading the model and are therefore worth preserving.

Graph Mode turns complex tasks into transparent, dependency-aware execution graphs instead of relying on an open-ended agent loop.

It breaks work into explicit nodes with dependencies, access levels, expected outputs, evidence requirements, attempt limits, and clear statuses. Graph Mode can run independent research or inspection branches in parallel, safely join their results, verify completion with deterministic evidence, and perform one bounded repair cycle when verification fails.

Use it for repository audits, feature implementation, parallel research, maker-reviewer workflows, monitoring, and other multi-step tasks where control flow and proof of completion matter.

Graph Mode does not expand the user’s permissions or scope. External writes, destructive actions, and materially ambiguous decisions remain approval-gated. Every run ends with a clear terminal state and reports the executed path, evidence, changes, blockers, skipped branches, and remaining uncertainty.

release.description: Open-source full-SDLC framework with graph-native project knowledge for agentic development.

interface.long_description:
NaCl (reading as Natrium Chloride) is an open-source full-SDLC framework, and its core innovation is how it solves the hardest problem in agentic development: storing and retrieving project knowledge. Instead of markdown specs that agents must re-read every session, all project knowledge — requirements, architecture decisions, entities, rules, and their relationships — lives in a Neo4j knowledge graph as first-class queryable objects. The measured effect: planning a single use case takes ~550 tokens (one targeted Cypher query) instead of ~150,000 tokens (reading a ~70-file markdown spec, because the agent doesn't know in advance where the relevant facts live) — a 99.6% reduction in context per use case, repeated in every planning session.

Around the graph we've built the full tooling for agentic development and testing: 57 skills covering BA → SA → TDD development → review → QA → release, quality gates before production, and an autonomous goal orchestrator (/nacl-goal). The framework answers "how is this built and why" for any part of the system, regardless of project scale or iteration count. Benchmarked on a real production project (EV charging station management): a classical team was estimated at 5,831 person-hours; running fully on NaCl the same scope takes 1,480 person-hours — 4x fewer person-hours and 60% lower cost.

Use this skill whenever the user needs a mental model of Jinkō projects, folders, project items, snapshots, sources, extracts, protocols, trials, calibration, virtual populations, references, or modeling context; when translating between generic terms and Jinkō terminology; or when an agent needs orientation before navigating or modifying Jinkō artifacts. This skill is conceptual and terminology-focused; use dedicated jinko-* workflow skills for creating or editing specific artifacts.

interface.default_prompt: Use $jinko-context to explain the Jinkō project structure and terminology.

skills.name: jinko-data-table
skills.description: Create or inspect Jinkō data tables via the jinko-sdk. Use this skill whenever the user wants to upload observed data for trial overlays or calibration objectives from CSV, SQLite, or pandas DataFrame; check data-table schema columns; inspect existing data tables; or verify metadata.public.validForFitnessFunction. Do not use this skill for output sets; use jinko-output-set for that.

interface.short_description: Create and inspect Jinkō data tables
interface.default_prompt: Use $jinko-data-table to upload and validate observed trial data.

skills.name: jinko-document
skills.description: Create or update a Jinkō document from markdown through the jinko-sdk, including headings, tables, code blocks, links to Jinkō project items, uploaded images, and links to existing Jinkō References. Use this skill whenever the user wants to turn local markdown into a Jinkō document, refresh an existing document from edited markdown, prepare markdown so Jinkō renders cards and images correctly, or cite existing project References.

interface.default_prompt: Use $jinko-document to turn my Markdown into a Jinkō document.

skills.name: jinko-model
skills.description: Build or edit a Jinkō computational model (QSP/PK-PD) via the jinko-sdk: parameters, categorical parameters, compartments, species, ODEs, reactions, dosing events, algebraic rules, baseline checks, solving options, units, and component tags. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create a model from scratch, create an empty model, edit an existing model, add or modify components, apply input/source/output tags, configure unit checking, define model-level dosing events, validate diagnostics, or debug model sanity or simple_solve errors. Prefer editing existing models over recreating them. Do not use this skill for running trials; use jinko-trial for trial execution.

interface.short_description: Build and debug QSP and PK-PD models
interface.default_prompt: Use $jinko-model to build or update my Jinkō computational model.

skills.name: jinko-output-set
skills.description: Create, inspect, validate, and incrementally edit Jinkō output sets via the jinko-sdk: simple output sets (measure designs) that list scalar measures derived from model outputs, and advanced output sets (scoring designs) that define constraints, scalars, and weighted objectives for scoring virtual populations. Validate scoring expressions and read diagnostics before attaching an output set elsewhere. Do not use this skill for attaching a simple or advanced output set to a trial and running it; use jinko-trial for that. Do not use this skill for data-table creation or fitness-function metadata; use jinko-data-table for that. Do not use this skill for calibration setup or CMA-ES options.

interface.default_prompt: Use $jinko-output-set to design and validate an output set.

skills.name: jinko-protocol
skills.description: Design or edit multi-arm Jinkō protocol designs via the jinko-sdk. Use this skill whenever the user wants to compare doses, schedules, administration routes, treatment activation flags, or combinations of treatments by overriding model component values per arm. Protocol designs assign values to model-defined inputs; dosing functions, schedule parameterization, treatment activation logic, and administration-mode logic belong in the model. Use jinko-model when those functions or inputs do not exist yet. Use jinko-trial for running trials.

interface.default_prompt: Use $jinko-protocol to edit a multi-arm Jinkō protocol design.

skills.name: jinko-reference

skills.name: compensation-quantifier
skills.description: Builds a compensation or damages claim head by head, using only the figures actually supplied, showing the arithmetic and flagging any head that is claimed without a supporting figure. This is a quantification tool, not a merits assessment — it does not decide whether the underlying claim succeeds; pair it with deficiency-analyst or product-liability-analyst for that. Fires for any compensation or damages claim, consumer or otherwise, wherever loss needs to be built up head by head from supplied figures.

skills.name: consumer-complaint-drafter
skills.description: Drafts a consumer complaint — the formal filing that states the parties, establishes the forum's jurisdiction, particularises the defect, deficiency, or unfair trade practice alleged, and states the relief sought. Side-specific — drafted for the complainant, against the opposite party. skills.name: deficiency-analyst

Use this whenever a user wants to know if a set of facts clears that threshold — including phrasings like "does this actually count as deficiency in service", "is this an unfair trade practice or just a bad experience", "test whether we have a viable consumer complaint here", "what's our exposure if a customer alleges deficiency", or "walk through whether these facts meet the test". Distinct from consumer-complaint-drafter, which states the allegation as instructed; this tests whether it actually holds up. release.description: Rules for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech.

interface.long_description:
Controlled Czech is an open specification for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech, packaged as a skill. Use it when writing, editing or reviewing Czech documentation, specifications, ADRs, issues, pull request descriptions, runbooks and AI agent instructions.

Every rule has a stable identifier (CCxxx), so the agent can load a single rule instead of the whole specification and every suggestion can be traced back to it. Only the skill description enters the context up front; the full rules load when Czech text is actually being written.

The repository also ships a deterministic linter written in Go (controlled-czech check). It runs offline, uses no LLM and never rewrites text, so the same rules can gate documentation in CI with --fail-on-warning.

Not intended for marketing copy, fiction, personal communication or brand voice.

release.description: OKRs as markdown files in your own repo, with an AI coach that checks new work against your key results, pre-drafts weekly check-ins, and parks distractions.

interface.short_description: OKRs as files, with a coach
interface.long_description:
okrdev turns OKRs into markdown files in your own repository and puts an AI coach beside them. The coach checks new work against your key results before it starts, pre-drafts the weekly check-in from git history and merged pull requests, and parks distractions instead of letting them become this week's work.

It installs on an adoption ladder and never installs a level you did not ask for. Level 0 is a parking lot and takes ten minutes. Level 1 adds a mission, cycle objectives, check-ins and a scored retro. Level 2 adds collaboration rails for teams shipping through pull requests.

The coach never blocks. It classifies, it argues, and when you overrule it, it logs the judgment call with your reason so the next planning session has a record instead of a memory.

No MCP servers, no telemetry, no account, no network calls of its own. Everything it produces is a file in your repository, under your git history and your access control. Delete the okrdev directory and the marked block in your agent instructions file, and it never existed.

release.description: Elegant HTML used-car buyer reports with exact-powertrain research, ownership costs, dealer risk, value, and negotiation.

interface.long_description:
Do not buy the badge—investigate the exact car. CarSleuth turns a listing URL, screenshot, VIN, vehicle-history report, or pasted vehicle details into an elegant, evidence-led buyer report.

It resolves the exact engine, transmission, battery, and drivetrain before judging reliability; maps costly failure modes; places the vehicle on its mileage-specific maintenance timeline; checks public VIN, recall, auction, accident, title, and listing clues; and examines repairability, fuel requirements, driving dynamics, ownership exposure, local value, and dealership transaction risk.

Standard and Deep investigations produce responsive self-contained HTML reports with a verdict card, score ring, value metrics, dealership grade, evidence tags, risk cards, cost tables, score bars, inspection priorities, negotiation guidance, and linked sources. A deterministic renderer owns the design, keeping generation fast and token-efficient. Rapid scans remain concise in chat.

CarSleuth keeps verified facts, recurring patterns, anecdotes, seller claims, and unknowns separate. It never treats a public VIN search as CARFAX, missing records as a clean history, or brand reputation as proof that a specific car is reliable.

Research-based decision support only. It does not replace an independent mechanical inspection or official ownership, title, lien, recall, insurance, and registration checks.

release.description: A gated, lecturer-in-the-loop workflow with guided, course-adaptive evidence-grounded redesign.

interface.long_description:
◆ LECTURER / TEACHER CONTROL • You retain every consequential decision. The Course Redesign Orchestrator is the sole lecturer-facing interface.
◆ SPECIALIST TEAM (10) • Course Mapper and Learning-Outcomes Auditor; Active-Learning Researcher; AI Integration and AI-Competence Researcher; Student Experience, Accessibility and Workload Proxy Critic; Assessment and Constructive-Alignment Designer. • Source Verification and Citation Auditor; Evidence and Feasibility Red Team; Learning Designer; Learning Material Designer; Artefact Accessibility and Visual QA Auditor. The student-experience role is a design-review proxy and never authorises identifiable student data.
◆ GATED WORKFLOW • Gate 0A: verify ownership/processing authority, sensitivity, student data, protected assessment and environment before any source path or content. • Gate 0: confirm sources, rights, tools and egress. Gate 1: confirm the course brief and a fresh run. • HITL 1: approve focus after preliminary mapping. Research, source verification, cross-specialist synthesis, assessment integration and red-team review lead to HITL 2. • Gate 3: approve the integrated blueprint and file plan. Material production creates only approved working copies, followed by evidence, accessibility, visual, alignment and assessment-security QA. • Verify production handoff before HITL 3; accept, revise or reject each artefact. • Request or decline final system review; the accepted run becomes complete and dormant until a later manual or separately approved scheduled trigger creates a fresh run.
◆ DECISION DIALOGUE • One unresolved question at a time. • Use a card only if the live host can show the complete option set plus custom answer. Verified current Codex in Plan mode: 2–3 explicit choices plus automatic Other. • If capacity is unknown, unavailable or exceeded, use ordinary chat with every valid numbered option plus Other, then wait. Never prune, hide or combine valid options to fit a card. • Long sets may use dependency-based chunks with every option visible; the lecturer may split, merge, reorder or rename them. • Preserve custom answers verbatim, show editable recaps, never preselect recommendations and fail closed on uncertainty.
◆ BOUNDARY • The plugin does not register schedules, start runs, publish content, add connectors or change permissions.

interface.long_description: agentmarkup generates the machine-readable layer of a website at build time: llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data, markdown mirrors, AI-crawler robots.txt rules and Content-Signal headers, then validates what the build actually produced. It works out which layer owns your final HTML and installs the matching adapter rather than guessing from what is already in package.json: Vite, Astro, Next or Nuxt, plus a framework-agnostic CLI for any other directory of built HTML, and core helpers for custom pipelines and dynamic SSR routes. Inspecting your repo is read-only. Validation is deterministic: a missing required field is an error, a missing recommended field is a warning. There is no score, grade or percentage. Existing curated llms.txt, robots.txt, _headers and JSON-LD are preserved unless you explicitly opt into replacement. Open source and MIT licensed.

interface.long_description: Classic SEO asks whether you rank. release.description: Tighten prose or write unambiguous technical documentation with two complementary writing skills.

interface.long_description:
Plain English tightens ai writing. Paste prose and it flags each weak sentence with a fix and hands back a cleaned version. 

The problem is old. In 1946 George Orwell wrote Politics and the English Language against prose that hides meaning: passive voice, abstract nouns, Latin where a plain word would do, metaphors dead from overuse. In 1948 Sir Ernest Gowers wrote Plain Words for the British civil service and turned the same instinct into working rules. Between them they solved most of it. Language models then added a dialect of their own: em-dashes everywhere, words like delve and leverage, preamble, summary closers, lists padded to three, stacked hedges, "studies show" with no study. So the skill runs two passes, Orwell and Gowers first, then the model habits. Your meaning and voice stay.

The plugin also includes Simple English, a separate skill for technical documentation. It follows ASD-STE100, the controlled language aerospace has written maintenance manuals in since 1986. Documentation goes there; prose with a voice goes to Plain English. The two never run on the same text..
interface.default_prompt: Rewrite this in plain English without changing its meaning.
default_prompts: Rewrite this in plain English without changing its meaning.

Also run as a self-audit pass before delivering long-form prose (essays, blog posts, articles, reports) so the output isn't recognisably AI-generated. Three modes: audit (flag + suggest), rewrite (deliver cleaned prose), edit (fix a named file in place). Technical documentation routes to the simple-english skill instead.

Ask instead. “How much is my electricity bill?” HomeOps finds the email, opens the actual PDF where there is one, and tells you the amount, the period, and when it's due. When something isn't stated — no due date, an unclear figure — it says so, rather than filling the gap with a guess. It can remind you before a bill falls due, and check each week for the next one from a provider you name. Those checks belong to you: they live in ChatGPT, and you can pause or delete them whenever you like. And here's the part most apps can't say. HomeOps has no account, no database, no server. It isn't that we promise not to keep your bills — there is nowhere for them to go.

release.description: Sustained mathematical research with auditable claims, dependencies and reproducible experiments

interface.long_description: Pursue research goals across distinct routes, track exact claim revisions and evidence dependencies, audit proofs and sources, and record reproducible bounded experiments. Portable skills with optional local Python tooling.
interface.default_prompt: Pursue this conjecture through distinct proof and counterexample routes.
default_prompts: Pursue this conjecture through distinct proof and counterexample routes.
Check which claims depend on this lemma and which evidence is stale.
Audit this proof and isolate the first unproved implication.

skills.name: computation-audit
skills.description: Design, run, or audit a mathematical computation that supports a research claim, including symbolic, exact, finite-field, representation-theoretic, homological, or numerical experiments. Use when correctness, provenance, tested range, reproducibility, or interpretation matters. Do not present bounded output as a universal proof.

interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:computation-audit to validate this mathematical computation and its scope.

skills.name: literature-check
skills.description: Verify an external mathematical theorem, citation, notation translation, source-dependent implication, or bounded novelty claim, reusing authorized project-local source copies when available. Use when a proof relies on a named paper/result, when exact hypotheses or versions matter, when the user asks whether a claim is known, or when an authenticated mathematical source should be cached for later checks. Prefer primary sources and record the search scope. Do not treat snippets or failed searches as proof or global novelty.

interface.short_description: Verify or cache a mathematical source
interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:literature-check to verify the exact source, hypotheses, and implication.

skills.name: manuscript-integrate
skills.description: Integrate an already validated mathematical result, correction, citation, or referee response into an authoritative LaTeX manuscript while preserving hypotheses, evidence status, notation, and dependencies. Use only when the user explicitly requests manuscript integration. Do not use to invent a proof or to perform routine copyediting.

interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:manuscript-integrate to transfer this validated result into the live manuscript.

skills.name: proof-audit
skills.description: Adversarially audit an existing mathematical claim, proof, derivation, diagram, or theorem dependency for correctness. Use for requests to verify, referee, stress-test, type-check, find gaps, or isolate the exact remaining implication. Default to read-only. Do not use to invent a substantially new proof route or merely copyedit prose.

interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:proof-audit to stress-test this claim and isolate the exact gap.

skills.name: proofread-math
skills.description: Conservatively proofread mathematical prose and LaTeX for grammar, typography, syntax, notation consistency, cross-references, and uniquely forced local mathematical typos. Use for explicit math-proofreading requests and final self-review of theorem-, proof-, or equation-heavy edits. Do not invent, replace, shorten, or substantively repair proofs.

interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:proofread-math to proofread this mathematical LaTeX conservatively.

skills.name: research-attempt
skills.description: Run one bounded, auditable mathematical research route: a proof attempt, reduction, counterexample search, source-dependent implication, or claim-supporting computation. Use when the user explicitly asks to attack a research question or invokes this skill. Do not use for a sustained multi-route investigation that continues after failed approaches, routine editing, explanation, or an unchanged verification rerun.

interface.short_description: Run one bounded mathematical research route
interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:research-attempt to pursue one bounded, auditable mathematical route.

skills.name: research-init
skills.description: Initialize, retrofit, or refresh an AI-assisted mathematical research repository. Use only when the user explicitly asks to set up or substantially revise AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, research workflow files, or the repository's agent architecture. Inspect first, interview adaptively, propose a reviewed file plan, and default to no repository-local skills because canonical workflows come from the mathbox plugin.

interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:research-init to inspect and configure this mathematical research repository.

skills.name: research-program
skills.description: Pursue a substantial mathematical research goal across multiple proof, counterexample, literature, and computational routes. Use when the user asks for sustained investigation, several approaches, a breakthrough, or continuation until a goal is reached. Coordinate successive research attempts and preserve their evidence. Do not use for a single bounded lemma attempt, ordinary explanation, proofreading, or a read-only project retrospective.

interface.short_description: Pursue a goal across multiple research routes
interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:research-program to pursue this research goal through distinct routes, preserving evidence and continuing after failed attempts.

skills.name: research-retrospective
skills.description: Reconcile a mathematical research repository's current claims, proofs, computations, status, literature dependencies, and failed routes, then recommend the next bounded research moves. Use only when the user asks for a project review, weekly/monthly retrospective, prioritization, a prose project handoff, or “what should I do next?”. Do not use to operate a .mathbox ledger or to generate its dependency-aware handoff. Default to read-only.

interface.short_description: Reconcile project state and choose next routes
interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:research-retrospective to review this mathematics project and prioritize the next bounded routes.

skills.name: research-state
skills.description: Track exact mathematical claims, evidence revisions, dependency impact, audit provenance, research routes, and parallel or delayed executions in a local append-only ledger. Use when a project has a .mathbox ledger or the user asks for executable research-state tracking, stale-evidence detection, run reconciliation, or a dependency-aware handoff generated from recorded events. Do not initialize state for a casual math question, replace proof auditing with metadata validation, or write a prose project retrospective from status files.

interface.short_description: Track evidence, dependencies and research runs
interface.default_prompt: Use $mathbox:research-state to check this project’s claim dependencies, stale evidence, route executions and next research routes.

release.description: Audit AI coding sessions and assistant configs with the locally installed skarn CLI: leaked credentials and risky hooks or MCP servers, reported on this machine with every secret masked.

interface.long_description:
Skarn is a command-line security scanner for AI coding sessions. The audit skill, skarn-audit, teaches the model to run the skarn CLI on this machine and act on what it reports.

The skill runs two passes. skarn assess reads the session transcripts that AI coding assistants have already written to disk and reports leaked credentials, prompt injection, exfiltration attempts, and the chains that connect them; each finding carries the standards mappings that apply to it, drawn from MITRE ATLAS, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025, the OWASP Agentic Top 10, and CWE. skarn vet reads the assistant configuration files on the same machine and reports risky declarations: hooks, MCP servers, and permission grants that could run remote code or send data off the machine.

Both passes run entirely on this machine and make no network call. Neither modifies a session transcript or a configuration file, and every credential value in the output is masked, so a finding names a rule and a masked preview and never the credential itself. Skarn surfaces findings and does not rotate a credential or edit a configuration on its own: the skill proposes, and the user decides. The one thing the skill can write is a baseline entry recording a finding the user has explicitly confirmed as a false positive.

The skill runs a local shell command, so it is offered in Codex. It does not carry the skarn binary, which is installed separately:

brew install skarn-security/tap/skarn
npm install -g @skarn-security/skarn
Release binaries: https://github.com/skarn-security/skarn-dist/releases/latest

When the binary is not installed, the skill says how to install it and stops rather than inventing a result. skarn assess and skarn vet need no account and no license.

Skarn also ships a hook that inspects a tool call before Codex runs it, and a skill that reconstructs recent work from session history. Both are distributed through the plugin marketplace at https://github.com/skarn-security/agent-guard.

Documentation: https://getskarn.com/integrations/
Support: hello@getskarn.com

release.description: Follow-ups, matter updates, meeting briefs, and prospect signals for law firm partners, sourced from the inbox you already have and the public web.

interface.long_description:
Most business development support tools want your data and tell you what to do. Maeve Lite reads the inbox you already have, keeps everything inside your ChatGPT workspace, quotes rather than guesses, and never touches a deadline.

Five skills for the partner who runs relationships out of email: Follow-up Radar finds what you owe, what you're waiting on, and which prospect threads have gone quiet. Matter Pulse turns recent mail into update-ready litigation and deal updates for your business development or operations team. Meeting Brief gives you the one page you read before a call, built from your own history with the people in the room. Week Ahead lays out what's scheduled, what's due, and what needs preparing. Client News Monitor finds recent public developments about a named prospect or client and their company, with an opened source behind every fact.

Built for how relationship-owning lawyers actually work. The mailbox is treated as the record because the CRM rarely is. Every line, date, client scope and output cites the email it came from, so you can verify it in one step. The output is a reading of your mail, not a floating recommendation.

Nothing leaves your workspace. The mailbox skills use the Gmail or Outlook account already authorized in ChatGPT and are read-only by default; Follow-up Radar and Matter Pulse can create one unsent draft on explicit request, and no skill ever sends email. Client News Monitor uses public web search only and never touches email or other connected data. Maeve operates no server behind these skills: no analytics, no callbacks, and no transfer of prompts, outputs, mailbox content, or credentials to Maeve. Confidential matter details never go into a web query.

Intended for ChatGPT Business or Enterprise workspaces, where terms exclude training on your content. Maeve Lite does not provide legal advice. Maeve Lite runs on one partner's mailbox; Maeve brings the same signals firm-wide across matters, people, and clients — for enterprise product contact www.maeven.ai.

release.description: Offline, inert context migration across supported coding agents

interface.long_description: Portable Resume migrates bounded context from your previous local coding-agent sessions into a fresh session. One resume skill per supported source (17 sources: Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Cline, Codex CLI, Crush, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, goose, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Kimi CLI / Kimi Code CLI, OpenClaw, OpenCode, OpenHands, Pi agent, Qwen Code) reads that agent's own on-disk session store, selects the newest session recorded for the current working directory where the source records one (a session without a recorded directory may remain eligible, depending on the adapter, and OpenHands has no directory filter), and prints an inert, best-effort redacted markdown handoff that the destination agent reads as data and summarizes; during a skill invocation the host and its model provider receive that output directly. Everything runs locally with Python's standard library: the bundled reader never contacts the network, never invokes the source agent's CLI, never modifies the source store, and ships no MCP server, credentials, scheduler or background service. Recovered text is marked untrusted and stale, and redaction is best-effort rather than complete data-loss prevention. This is offline context migration, not live session restore.

release.description: AI art direction and source-aware visual reconstruction with flat editorial composition, selective halftone, tactile collage, revision continuity, hierarchy stabilization, and strict source-text control.

interface.long_description: Press Print 2.0 reads a user-supplied image before reconstructing it, identifies what must survive, stabilizes weak or ambiguous hierarchy when needed, forms a source-specific art-direction thesis, and rebuilds the image through flattened editorial composition, source-derived cropping and scale shifts, selective photographic retention, visible halftone and duotone, graphic fields, controlled tactile collage, and modernist hierarchy. Clear requests execute directly; vague requests are handled with autonomous judgment unless real ambiguity requires clarification. Ansight gives your coding agent runtime evidence from real mobile apps, so it can debug and verify what actually happened instead of guessing from source code.

Install the Ansight SDK into an iOS, Android, .NET MAUI, React Native, Flutter, or Capacitor app, and every development session records logs, network requests, telemetry, screenshots, visual trees, and touches. This plugin's 27 skills let the agent use that evidence through the Ansight CLI:

• Investigate a recorded session: bracket a time window and correlate logs, failed requests, screenshots, and UI trees around an error
• Operate a running app: boot a simulator or emulator, launch the app, tap and type through the semantic UI, and capture before-and-after evidence
• Call remote tools the app exposes for authoritative in-process state
• Annotate sessions for review
• Score automation readiness and automation-ID coverage
• Author and run repeatable, source-controlled UI tests
• Add platform-specific SDK setup and custom remote tools for each supported framework

Requirements: the Ansight CLI is installed separately, and live workflows need a development or QA build with the SDK integrated plus execution access to the machine running the Ansight host. Installing the plugin in a cloud-only environment does not by itself provide access to a local device or simulator.

release.description: Carry useful work across Codex chats with local memory you control

interface.long_description:
Eggshell helps independent Codex chats reuse relevant prior work. It saves requests, tool results, and conclusions in local .egg files, then supplies selected findings when a related task begins. Codex can reuse supported findings, check changed facts, and explain what remains unverified.

Memory organization and retrieval run locally without generative LLM calls. Ordinary Codex task and handoff tokens still count toward model usage. Eggshell has no hosted memory service or telemetry.

This plugin provides local setup, inspection, and memory controls. First use requires macOS or Linux on ARM64 or x86-64, Python 3, downloads of the runtime and search model, project initialization, and review of Codex command hooks. Automatic memory requires those local hooks; this plugin does not provide automatic memory in ChatGPT.

Inspect the delivered handoff with !egg graph and its selection with !egg why. Tool observations can be saved while a turn is running. !egg drop clears the active turn but retains saved observations and queued commits. Use !egg off to disable recording and handoff delivery.

release.description:
Shopping online feels like a trust exercise you're destined to fail. You find a product with 5,000 five-star reviews, but half of them look like bots and the other half are people just happy the box arrived on time. It's impossible to know what's actually good.

This app cuts through the junk. You tell us what you need, and we ignore the sponsored placements to build you a shortlist based on merit, not marketing budget.

This is where we do the heavy lifting. We don't just show you the star rating; we dig into the text to find the truth. We scan forum discussions, Reddit threads, and verified purchase comments to summarize the actual consensus.

- The Good: We highlight the specific features real people love.
- The Bad: We spot the patterns in the complaints - like if a "waterproof" boot actually leaks after a month.
- The Verdict: We tell you if the hype is real or if you should keep looking.

Once you have a few options, we stack them side-by-side. You get a clean look at the specs and prices without opening twenty tabs or building your own spreadsheet. It's the deep research you want to do, done for you in seconds.

release.description:
Postify is a social media scheduling tool for teams: one calendar for the accounts you publish to, with drafts, scheduling, and delivery analytics in one place. The Postify plugin lets ChatGPT work that calendar with you: list posts and open a specific one, see which channels are connected, draft a new post, move a scheduled post to a different time, search your media library for an image you already uploaded, ask for a suggested posting time, publish a post immediately, or delete one. It can also pull performance figures for posts already delivered, and search Postify's own documentation when you need to know how something works.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, and issued tokens are bound to the Postify MCP endpoint. You choose scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never registered for the session, so the assistant cannot see it. Connected apps are listed in Settings and can be revoked there, and every tool call is written to an audit log you can read in the app.

The two irreversible actions — publishing and deleting — are deliberately gated twice. First, an organization setting controls whether an AI assistant may perform them at all, and that setting can only be turned on by a person inside Postify; no AI credential carries the scope needed to enable it. Second, with the setting on, the first call returns a confirmation request with a short-lived token bound to the exact arguments, which must be echoed back on a second call before anything is published or deleted. Expect that first response — it is the safety step working, not an error.

release.description:
VoiceLabs is a browser-based voice studio for text-to-speech and transcription. The VoiceLabs plugin lets ChatGPT work with your voice library directly: list the voice profiles on your account, provision a built-in preset voice when one is missing, generate spoken audio from text, transcribe an audio clip to text, browse your saved captures, and check the status of a generation you started earlier.

Access is granted through OAuth 2.1 with a consent screen that shows exactly which scopes you are approving: voice:read for browsing your library, voice:generate for producing audio and transcripts. You can revoke a connection at any time from Connected Apps in the VoiceLabs app, which invalidates both the stored consent and any live access tokens. Voice cloning is deliberately excluded from this surface. The plugin can only provision VoiceLabs' own preset voices, because uploading samples of a real person's voice requires a consent an agent cannot hold on your behalf.

Generated audio is returned as a short-lived signed link rather than a permanent public URL, and every tool call is recorded on the account's audit trail with its outcome.

release.description:
Musafir.com Visa answers visa questions from Musafir.com's live product catalogue: whether you need a visa at all, what it costs, which documents are needed, how long it takes, and whether Musafir.com can process it for you. Where a visa needs an in-person appointment, it also shows the visa centres with published availability and the dates they were last showing as open, so you can see roughly how soon is realistic before you commit to anything.

Visa rules, fees and processing times change constantly and differ by the passport you hold, so remembered or published figures are routinely out of date for the person asking. Every answer here comes from the catalogue that prices Musafir.com's own bookings, and each one names the market it applies to.

Ask about a destination, compare several, or check what paperwork you need and how each document is handed over, whether that is uploaded online, taken to a visa centre or couriered. When you are ready to apply, you are handed the matching page on Musafir.com with your details already carried across, and Musafir.com books the appointment for you once your application is in.

Musafir.com currently serves travellers applying from the UAE. If you live somewhere Musafir.com does not yet cover, the connector says so rather than quoting you a price for a process you cannot use.

This connector is read-only. It cannot access your account, view or change an order, hold or book an appointment, or take a payment. Appointment availability is what the visa centre was last publishing, not a reservation and not a guarantee. It tells you what Musafir.com can process, which is not the same as what a government requires, and it never predicts whether a visa will be approved.

release.description:
Riveter turns web research into structured data. Give Claude a list of companies, people, or URLs and ask for new columns: product descriptions, revenue, deep analysis, company headcount, link traces, pricing, tech stack analysis, contact details, a classification, a summary, etc. Riveter runs an AI agent per row that searches, reads pages, and fills in each cell with a sourced answer.

What you can do

- Enrich rows you already have. Paste a list or point at a saved enrichment and get the new columns back. Up to 10,000 rows per run.
- Build a list from a description. "Every lawfirm in Indiana", "every YC W24 company in healthcare", "competitors of Stripe". Riveter generates the rows, and can enrich them in the same run.
- Scrape a page. Clean text or markdown from any URL, including JavaScript-rendered pages.
- Search the web. One-shot search results, or a research agent that answers a question with a structured, schema-shaped response.
- Extract records from a site. Define the fields you want and pull them from listings, directories, or catalogs as JSON.
- Monitor for changes. Run a saved enrichment daily, weekly, or monthly and get alerts or webhooks when values change.

How it works

Long runs are asynchronous. Claude starts the run, checks status, and fetches results when they are ready. Every run has an id you can come back to later, and results stay available in your Riveter account.

Useful for freight forwarders, importers and exporters, and anyone who handles shipping documents and wants an answer without logging into three carrier websites.
